title: node:http2: deliver a settings() acknowledgement in the async context of its caller
author: robobun
summary: - `session.settings(settings, cb)` runs `cb` and that frame's `'localSettings'` in the async context the session was made in. Node runs both in the caller's context. summary: - `fs.writev(fd, bufs, fn, cb)` and `fs.readv(fd, bufs, fn, cb)` call `fn` and never `cb`. title: `bun check`: resolve a page's scripts with the bundler's resolver
author: robobun
summary: - `bun check <file>`, `bun --check` and `bun test --check` join a page's `src` text onto its folder (`imports_of_page`, `src/runtime/cli/check_command.rs:814`). - `./main` for `main.ts` is not checked. `./main.js` is a false `TS6053`. `bun build --check` is right.

title: css: fold hwb() above 100% to the gray W / (W + B)
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` and `Bun.color()` cap the whiteness and blackness of `hwb()` at 100%. `hwb(210 150% 40%)` prints `#b6b6b6`. CSS Color 4 gives `rgb(201, 201, 201)`. - The cause is `.clamp(0.0, 1.0)` in `parse_hsl_hwb_components` (`src/css/values/color.rs:1411`). CSS Color 4 removed that cap (w3c/csswg-drafts#8444).

title: fs.promises: reject a non-number offset in FileHandle.write before the default length uses it
author: robobun
summary: - `filehandle.write(buf, 1n)` rejects with a `TypeError` that has no `code` ("Invalid mix of BigInt and other type in subtraction."). Node rejects with `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`. An object offset has its `valueOf` called first, and a function offset writes the whole view. - The cause is `src/js/node/fs.promises.ts:650`: `length = buffer.byteLength - offset` runs before any check of `offset`. - A differential fuzz run against Node found it. No user reported it.

title: fs.promises.watch: settle an aborted next() on Node's tick and in listener order
author: robobun
summary: - `Promise.race([once(signal, "abort"), watch(dir, { signal })[Symbol.asyncIterator]().next()])` rejects with `AbortError` since Bun 1.4.0. Node and Bun 1.3.14 fulfil. No user reported it. - `next()` settles 2 ticks after the abort, and before the promises of abort listeners that were added earlier (`src/js/node/fs.promises.ts:100`). Since #30984, `events.once()` settles later than that.

title: socket: compute the Duplex and named pipe timeout in 64 bits, so `socket.timeout()` above 49.7 days does not wrap
author: robobun
summary: - `socket.timeout(seconds)` arms the wrong time on a Windows named pipe socket and on TLS over a node Duplex. Both compute `seconds * 1000` in 32 bits (`WindowsNamedPipe.rs:991`, `UpgradedDuplex.rs:697`). That wraps above 49.7 days. - On main, 1 year arms 17 days, `Infinity` arms 49.7 days, and 2^29 s arms no timer. A debug build panics: `attempt to multiply with overflow`. - No user reported it: the review of #45614 did. Only `tlsSocket._handle` reaches the Duplex socket.

title: bundler: keep the CommonJS wrapper of a package that a file writes to through require()
author: robobun
summary: On top of #46215. - `const React = require("react"); React.other = "patched"` fails in `bun build`: `error: Cannot assign to import "other"`. Node runs it. - Cause: `require()` of a listed package is an `import * as`, and `src/js_parser/fold.rs` makes the write target an import item.

title: bundler: skip __toESM for an unwrapped require() of a package that keeps its CommonJS wrapper
author: robobun
summary: Part of #12463 - In ESM output, `require("react")` gives a copy with getters and a `default` key when the package keeps its `__commonJS` wrapper. A write through an interop helper or a default import throws `TypeError: Cannot set property useLayoutEffect of #<Object> which has only a getter`. - Cause: `transpose_require` (`src/js_parser/p.rs`) makes the `require()` an unmarked `import * as`, and the linker wraps it in `__toESM`.

title: bun test: rank "no timeout" as the latest deadline for spawnSync in a concurrent group
author: robobun
summary: - A concurrent sibling's timeout ends the `Bun.spawnSync` child of a test with timeout `0`: `child: null SIGTERM after 104 ms`. Piped output is cut with exit code 0. - After an `await`, `TestRunner::get_active_timeout()` (`src/runtime/test_runner/jest.rs:174`) takes the latest deadline with `Timespec::order`. That order ranks `EPOCH` ("no timeout") below every deadline. Regression from #33832 (1.4.0).

title: Read Bun.serve integer options, socket.write offsets and matcher counts by value, so -0 is 0
author: robobun
summary: - A computed `-0` is refused where `0` is accepted. `Bun.serve({ idleTimeout: -0 })` throws `Bun.serve expects idleTimeout to be an integer`. `socket.write(buf, -0, 5)` throws `Expected byteOffset to be a integer for 'Socket.write'.` - `toBeArrayOfSize(-0)` and `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(-0)` throw a usage error. - Each reader gates on `JSValue::is_any_int()` (`src/jsc/JSValue.rs:247`). That is JSC's Int52 test, false for `-0`.

title: node:url: do not emit DEP0169 in a standalone executable
author: robobun
summary: Related to #16639 - A `bun build --compile` executable prints ``[DEP0169] DeprecationWarning: `url.parse()` behavior is not standardized`` for a call in a bundled dependency. `bun run` prints nothing. Example: express 5.3.0 on an absolute-form request (exit 1 with `--throw-deprecation`). - `urlParse` (`src/js/node/url.ts:138`) warns unless the caller's file is under `node_modules`. A bundled frame is named after the executable. With `--sourcemap` the pattern misses the relative name of a hoisted

title: parser: a `:` after `(b as B)` is not an arrow function return type (TypeScript)
author: robobun
summary: - In a `.ts` file, `a ? () => (b as B) : d => e` fails with `Expected ":" but found ";"`. `a ? (p): R => (b as B) : d => e` prints `a ? p : (R) => (b) => e` with no error. tsc accepts both. - `parse_paren_expr` (`src/js_parser/parse/mod.rs:574`) takes `(...) : T =>` as an arrow function when the items convert to parameters. `(b as B)`, `(b!)`, `(<B>b)`, `(b<T>)` and `((b))` convert: a cast leaves only the node of `b`.

title: shell(cat): stop the reader while every listener waits for its write
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #37901. Draft until that base is green and Windows CI ran this. - The builtin `cat` reads its input without bound while nothing takes its output. Under a memory limit, `yes | cat | head -c 60000000 | wc -c` aborts: `memory allocation of 536870912 bytes failed`, `panic(main thread): abort() called`. - `cat | sleep 0.3; /bin/cat` leaves `/bin/cat` 0 of 600,000 bytes (dash: 468,928). - Cause: `Cat::on_io_reader_chunk` (`src/runtime/shell/builtin/cat.rs`) queues every chunk on its `IOWrit

title: css: parse transform-origin, perspective-origin and mask-position with their own grammars
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #45197. - `transform-origin`, `perspective-origin` and `mask-position` never parse a real value. `.a{transform-origin:LEFT TOP}` prints as written, and `.a{transform-origin:STATIC}` prints `static`. - Three rows of the property table (`src/css/properties/properties_generated.rs:1825`, `:1830`, `:1844`) use the keyword enum of the `position` property. No issue reports this.

title: run --filter, publish -r: keep the dependency order around a dependency cycle
author: robobun
summary: - `bun run --filter` runs a script after the scripts of its workspace dependencies. If two selected packages depend on each other, or one lists itself, all of them lose that order, silently. - Cause: the `has_cycle` branch of `run_scripts_with_filter` (`src/runtime/cli/filter_run.rs:1096`) clears every edge. Since #38333 (1.4.0) a devDependency can close a cycle that 1.3.14 ran in order. - `bun publish -r` (unreleased) can put a package before a dependency outside its cycle.

title: bundler: say "imported file" only when require() names the file with the top-level await
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` refuses a `require()` that reaches a top-level await. A direct `require("./t.mjs")` prints `This require call is not allowed because the transitive dependency "t.mjs" contains a top-level await`. - The reverse is wrong too. `r.mjs` has the await and requires `i.mjs`, which imports `r.mjs`. bun prints `imported file "r.mjs"`. - Cause: `validate_tla` (`src/bundler/LinkerContext.rs:2229`) reads the path of the file that has the `require()`.

title: glob: stat a followed symlink that does not open before calling it broken
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.Glob` `scan()` returns a short list and no error when the directory behind a followed symlink fails to open. With one free descriptor, `**/*` returns `["plain.txt"]` and drops `link/file.txt`. - Cause: the glob walker's `WorkItemKind::Symlink` arm (`Iterator::next`, `src/glob/GlobWalker.rs:893`) handles every errno of the open, except ENOTDIR, as a broken link.

title: `bun lint --fix`: prefer-readonly resolves the enum type through the checker, or holds the fix back
author: robobun
summary: - The fix of `prefer-readonly` (`bun lint --type-aware --fix`) turns `private c = Color.Red` into `private readonly c = Color.Red`. The constructor assigns `Color.Green`, so the file fails `error TS2322: Type 'Color.Green' is not assignable to type 'Color.Red'`. - With an ESLint config or none, `import { Color }` is enough. With an oxlint config, a global enum is. - Cause: `get_type_annotation` (`src/lint/typescript/rules/prefer_readonly.rs:427` on main) resolves the name with `find_variable`, i

title: vscode: apply `bun.test.filePattern` to opened documents, match `*_test.*` and `*_spec.*` by default
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #23591 - With `bun.test.filePattern` set to `**/*.test.ts`, an opened `listing.spec.ts` gets a Bun row. `isTestFile` (`bun-test-controller.ts:138`) is a fixed regex, and the review of #20645 asked for the setting. - The default pattern (`package.json:74`) has `_test_` for `_test.`, so the Test Explorer misses `a_test.ts`, which `bun test` runs. The regex in `isTestFile` misses it too.

title: node:url: decide isInsideNodeModules in a native stack walk
author: robobun
summary: - A package that passes `url.parse` as a callback (`[u].map(url.parse)`) gets `[DEP0169] DeprecationWarning: url.parse() behavior is not standardized`. Node.js types DEP0169 "Application (non-`node_modules` code only)". - `isInsideNodeModules` (`src/js/internal/shared.ts:191`) let the first of 4 captured call sites outside a built-in module decide. The frame of `map` is named `[unknown]`, so it decided.

title: Stop the rejection pass after a report that no listener took, and print an error once under --unhandled-rejections=throw
author: robobun
summary: - `GlobalObject::handleRejectedPromises` (`src/jsc/bindings/ZigGlobalObject.cpp`) takes batches until its queue is empty. After a report that ends in an uncaught error no listener took, that report's listeners can reject again on every call, so the pass never returns. - Repro: `bun --unhandled-rejections=strict` with an async `unhandledRejection` listener that throws. One `Promise.reject()` prints `error:` without end. node exits with status 1. - `--unhandled-rejections=throw` prints each error

title: napi: open the per-call handle scope on the env's global object
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45981 - `bun test --isolate` crashes when a Node-API function created while one test file ran is called from a later file. On 1.3.14 the report decodes to `NapiHandleScope__append` <- `napi_value.set` <- `napi_create_promise`, a segfault at address 0x4. On main the null check from #31216 hides the segfault, so the values are silently unrooted and a collection during the call frees them (`ASSERTION FAILED: decontaminate()` in `StructureID.h`). - The cause is `NapiClass_ConstructorFunction`

title: node: $toClass installs the prototype of built-in constructors; EventEmitter reads it with $getPrototypeOf
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #32160 - A copy of the own properties of 47 built-in functions onto another function throws `TypeError: Attempting to change configurable attribute of unconfigurable property.` Node.js does not. - Cause: a function in a built-in module gets no `prototype`. 10 constructors assigned one (`src/js/node/events.ts:131`), and `$toClass` put one without `DontDelete`. - Two more. `events.ts:140` assigned `constructor`: `TypeError: Attempted to assign to readonly property.` after `Object.freeze(Obje

title: Remove dead code from bun_glob and bun_css
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - `Parsed.has_choice` in `src/glob/matcher.rs` is declared, set to `false`, assigned once and never read. It came with #45043. - The arm `(@gamut none ...)` of `define_colorspace!` in `src/css/values/color.rs` is never matched. The 14 invocations pass `unbounded`, `bounded` or `hsl_hwb`. - No lint reports them. rustc's `dead_code` counts an assignment as a use, and `unused_macro_rules` is not enabled (`Cargo.toml:217`, `:228`).

title: Bun.Image: measure a PNG palette in what pixels show over mid-grey
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #46182 and #45391: merge those first. No issue asked for this. - `png({ palette: true })` measures the stored bytes of an image that does not fit its palette. A pixel at alpha 20 weighs as much as an opaque one: a grey ramp under alpha 0 to 48 keeps 2 levels of alpha at 16 colours. - Cause: `split_boxes` and `map_floyd_steinberg` (`src/runtime/image/quantize.rs`) sum and compare RGBA bytes.

title: Blob: treat an empty type as no Content-Type in fetch and Bun.serve routes
author: robobun
summary: - `fetch()` sends `Content-Type:` with an empty value for a Blob body whose own type is empty: an S3 file with no `type`, or a typeless slice of `Bun.file(path, { type })` or of a `response.blob()` typed `application/pdf`. Node sends no header. Static and file routes do the same. - `Blob::has_content_type_from_user()` (`src/jsc/webcore_types.rs:387`) is true when `content_type_was_set` is set or the store is a file or S3 store. It ignores the type.

title: `bun check`: fix a false TS7022 when a default in a binding pattern reads a variable named like a type
author: robobun
summary: - `bun check` prints a false `error TS7022: 'width' implicitly has type 'any' because it does not have a type annotation and is referenced directly or indirectly in its own initializer.` for `interface width {}` beside `const { width, height = width } = { width: 2 }`. - `height` becomes `any`, so `const wrong: string = height` gets no TS2322, the only line `tsc` 7.0.2 prints. - Cause: `is_reference_within_one_of_the_patterns` (`src/sema/check/context.rs:299`) took the first declaration of the sy

title: Wait for input when a synchronous read of stdin gets EAGAIN
author: robobun
summary: - `bun repl` exits with code 0, no message, when `read(0)` fails with `EAGAIN`. `prompt()` returns `null`. - `O_NONBLOCK` is on the open file description, which fds 0, 1, 2 and other programs share. On a socket, Bun's `process.stdout` sets it. - `Repl::read_byte` (`src/runtime/cli/repl.rs:1176`) and Bun's other synchronous stdin readers take every read error for the end of input.

title: fs.watch: deliver every record the OS reports on POSIX, as libuv does
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45954 - `fs.watch(file)` on Linux drops the `change` event of the last write in a burst. A listener that stats the file on each event never sees the final size. - `ChangeEvent::should_emit` (`src/runtime/node/path_watcher.rs:226`) discards a record of the same path and kind within 1 ms of the last emitted one. Nothing re-arms a trailing event.

title: resolver: build each directory listing in one table of its final size
author: robobun
summary: - For each directory that it lists for a `DirInfo`, the resolver keeps a hash table for 64 entries (3,216 bytes), also for a directory with one entry. The process never frees it. - `reload()` of a `Bun.FileSystemRouter` over 50 folders keeps 425 KB per call (1.3.13: 81 KB). `bun --hot` keeps one table per dropped directory (#11083). - Cause: `new_entry.data.reserve(64)` at `src/resolver/resolver.rs:3477` and `:4686`. It is there so that inserts do not rehash.

title: process: queue signals for the regular event loop, whichever loop is current
author: robobun
summary: - A `process.on(<signal>)` listener that a macro adds never runs, and the process then ignores that signal: `still running 1.5 s after SIGINT; handler never ran`. A signal during a macro is lost. - `Bun__onPosixSignal` (`src/jsc/PosixSignalHandle.rs:68`) found the ring of pending signals through `vm.event_loop`, which is the macro loop while a macro runs.

title: bun check: do not add undefined to the type of a property when it is read
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45922 - `bun check` reports `TS2322: Type '{} | undefined' is not assignable to type '{}'` on `const t: typeof globalThis = { ...w }` with `w: { flags?: {} } & typeof globalThis` and `declare global { var flags: {} }`. tsc and tsgo report nothing. - The property `flags` of the intersection is optional, and its type is `{}`: a `var` of `globalThis` is not a class member, so tsc (`createUnionOrIntersectionProperty`) does not add `undefined`. The spread copies that type. Then the reader `typ

title: Bump WebKit: the int to string cache no longer churns a String per miss
author: robobun
summary: Part of #44792 - hyperid generates each id as `prefix + counter`. The counter is an int32 that goes up on every call, so it misses JSC's 1024 slot int to string cache every time. Under bun 1.4.2 that is 36 to 50 % slower than node 26 (reporter), and `"" + counter` alone is 38 ns against node's 16 ns on the same host here. - The miss path, `NumericStrings::addJSString(VM&, int)` in JSC, replaces the slot's `String` on every miss: a refcount drop on the evicted `StringImpl` on a cold line, then a

title: node:http, node:http2: give emit('connection') and allowHTTP1 connections the server's timers and error path
author: robobun
summary: - A connection that node:http parses in JS has no timer: a socket from `server.emit('connection', socket)`, or an HTTP/1.1 client of an `allowHTTP1` http2 server. Idle, or with half a request, it stays open. Node v26.3.0 ends it. No user report. - `connectionListenerHTTP1` (`src/js/internal/http1_server_fallback.ts`) arms no timeout. `checkConnections` (`src/js/node/_http_server.ts`) sweeps only native sockets. The listener's error handler emits `'clientError'` twice.

title: bun build --no-bundle: report a CSS error with its file, line and column
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build --no-bundle e.css` prints `error: Unexpected end of input parsing`: no file, line or column. The bundled build adds `at /tmp/nb/e.css:4:1`. No user reported this. - `Transpiler::build_css_output` (`src/bundler/transpiler.rs:3093`, `:3102`, `:3123`) logs parse, minify and print errors with no source or location.

title: Bun.Image: count transparent pixels and swap only misplaced ones in palette splits
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none Stacked on #45391: merge that first. - `png({ palette: true })` copies every pixel of an image that does not fit its palette. Each split of a box sums and moves every pixel below its cut. - A transparent background is one colour and often most of the image. Every split of its box reads it again (`split_boxes`, `src/runtime/image/quantize.rs`).

title: install: don't exit the process from lifecycle-script failures
author: QQSHI13
summary: Part of a stack toward a programmatic `install` API (#5414), built with @QQSHI13. - **#45323** (this PR's parent commit `b38af3f6`): stops `bun install --analyze` from `exit(0)`ing inside the bundler scan — the first de-exit. - **This PR** (`4ea9e3a1`): de-exits the lifecycle-script failures, stacked directly on #45323 (`b38af3f6` is this branch's parent). A lifecycle-script (postinstall/preinstall) failure, or a spawn failure, called `Global::exit` from inside an async callback — killing the wh

title: Bun.Image: read every option of a format or modulate() call before the recorded options
author: robobun
summary: - A format call or `modulate()` call made from an option getter of the same method is lost. `img.webp({ get quality() { img.webp({ lossless: true }); return 50; } })` encodes lossy WebP. - `set_format` and `do_modulate` (`src/runtime/image/Image.rs:567`, `:531`) copy the recorded options, read the options object, then store the copy. A getter runs in between. - No user reported this. A review comment on #45606 did. `img.webp({ ...options })` avoids it today.

title: FileSink: answer the fast path's write callbacks from the sink's drain
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45882 - `child.stdin.write(small, cb)` after the child closed its stdin calls `cb(null)`, emits no `'error'`, and stays writable. Node reports `EPIPE` to both and destroys the stream. - A chunk under 4 KiB is buffered, reported as written, and sent at the end of the tick. When that send fails, `FileSink::on_auto_flush` and `on_error` (`src/runtime/webcore/FileSink.rs`) deliver the error only to a pending promise. With none, it is dropped.

title: bun_alloc: BSS stores take `&self` over `UnsafeCell` slot buffers
author: robobun
summary: - A pointer from a BSS store does not survive a later call on the store. Miri reports `Undefined Behavior: write access through <tag> at alloc[..] is forbidden`, and across threads `Data race detected between (1) non-atomic write ... and (2) retag read`. No crash or report is known. - Each call forms a reference over every slot: `(*this).backing_buf.as_mut_ptr()` (`src/bun_alloc/lib.rs:1748`).

author: robobun

If the answer is yes: 1.4.4 or 1.5? | | main | this PR | Node 26 | - `new Blob([part])` and `new File([part], name)` with one in-memory Blob part return a copy of the part that keeps its `type`. The File API takes the bytes from the parts and the type from `options.type`. Node and browsers give `""`. Bun also gives `""` for

title: bun:test: compare only the expected value's own properties in toMatchObject and Bun.deepMatch
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45950 - `expect(Object.setPrototypeOf(["x"], null)).toMatchObject(["x"])`, `expect({ id: 1 }).toMatchObject(new Model({ id: 1 }))` (an enumerable method on `Model.prototype`) and an array whose prototype adds a field all fail. Jest's `expect` passes all three. `Bun.deepMatch` returns false for the same pairs. - `Bun__deepMatch` (`src/jsc/bindings/bindings.cpp:2222`) enumerates the expected value with `getPropertyNames` and `PrivateSymbolMode::Include`. That walks the prototype chain and c

title: test(ws-proxy): renegotiate only after the "renegotiating" frame is written
author: robobun
summary: - `test/js/first_party/ws/ws-proxy.test.ts` fails on Windows 2019 x64 (builds 128251, 128333, 128506) in "a message sent during a TLS renegotiation arrives after it". `request.forwarded[0].types` is `[22, 23]`, not `[23, 22]`, and the client closes with 1006. - The cause is the node origin of `startRenegotiatingWssServer("behind a message")` (`test/js/web/websocket/proxy-test-utils.ts:445`, added by #45720). It ran `send("renegotiating"); renegotiate(...)`. If the write of the 101 is not done, n

title: node:wasi: fd_pread and fd_pwrite need the read or write right
author: robobun
summary: Carries #45867 until it merges. #45867 explains the change from 63 to 76. - `fd_pread` and `fd_pwrite` pass on a descriptor with FD_SEEK and no right to read or write. A Go guest's `os.Open`, then `WriteAt`, changes the host file. Node.js v26.3.0 returns 76 (ENOTCAPABLE). - On main, `CHECK_FD` (`src/js/node/wasi.ts:712`) accepts any one right of the mask. `fd_pwrite` (`:980`) and `fd_pread` (`:1025`) also name FD_SEEK.

title: shell: stop running builtins and their pool work when a script is stopped
author: robobun
summary: Refs #11868 - Three things stop a `Bun.$` script: a JS error in a member, a Ctrl+C that kills a child, `Bun.ModuleGraph#dispose()`. Each ended only subprocesses (#42288). A builtin ran on. Since 1.4.1 (#39729), `child | yes` outlives the Ctrl+C. - `Interpreter::fail` (`src/runtime/shell/interpreter.rs:1373`) rejected under the shell's own frames. A `catch` block that turns the event loop ends in `panic: expected Node::Pipeline at Node#2, got Free`.

title: node:https: emit 'connection' at TCP accept, before the TLS handshake
author: robobun
summary: - `https.createServer()` does not see a connection until its TLS handshake ends: no `'connection'`, `getConnections()` is 0, `maxConnections` and `blockList` act after a full handshake. Node emits `'connection'` at TCP accept ([tls.md](https://nodejs.org/api/tls.html#event-connection)). - Cause: the filter thunk in `src/runtime/server/server_body.rs` drops the accept event (`if opened != 1 { return; }`).

title: bun:test fake timers: a zero-delay setTimeout is due now, so advanceTimersByTime(0) does not move the clock
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45906 - `jest.advanceTimersByTime(0)` moves the fake clock by 1 ms per call, with or without a pending timer. Jest and Vitest (sinon fake-timers) move it by 0 ms and still fire `setTimeout(fn, 0)`. - `js_value_to_countdown` (`src/runtime/timer/Timer.rs:173`) clamps a delay below 1 ms to 1, as node does for real timers. Under fake timers that puts `setTimeout(fn, 0)` at now+1. `advance_timers_by_time` (`FakeTimers.rs:457`) bumped an advance of 0 to 1 ms to reach it (#25915). The bump moves

title: bundler: take one copy per key for a top-level destructuring of a module namespace
author: robobun
summary: - A top-level `const { useState, version } = require("react")` keeps every export of React: 9,480 B against 939 B for two hand-written copies (React 19.3.1, `--production`). So does a pattern over an import. - The pattern uses the whole namespace, so step 6 (`scanImportsAndExports.rs:977`) makes its part depend on the namespace object.

title: Remove the unused options of generate-string-map.ts
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - `src/codegen/generate-string-map.ts` has four options that no spec sets: `emitKeys`, `emitCaseInsensitive`, `emitIndexOf` and `doc`. A dead-code sweep found them. They cause no failure. - The one spec is `src/js_parser/defines_table.string-map.ts`. No commit on any ref sets an option.

title: repl: run --preload / -r / --require / --import before the first evaluation
author: robobun
summary: Related to #4706 - `bun repl --preload ./setup.ts` (also `-r`, `--require`, `--import`) never runs `setup.ts`. A missing preload gives no error and exit code 0. `node -r` runs it. - `boot_repl_vm` stores the list in `vm.preload` (`src/runtime/cli/repl_command.rs:94`). Nothing calls the `load_preloads` hook, because the REPL loads no entry point.

title: pm trust: link the bins of the packages whose scripts it runs
author: robobun
summary: - `bun pm trust <pkg>` runs the blocked scripts of `<pkg>` but links no bin afterwards. A bin whose file a script writes is missing until the next `bun install`. Under the isolated linker, a dependent never gets it. - `bun install` links bins again after its scripts (`src/install/hoisted_install.rs:593`). `TrustCommand::exec` (`src/runtime/cli/pm_trusted_command.rs`) has no such pass.

title: Append non-UTF-8 bytes instead of formatting them: run --filter output, build names, CSS module hash, shell which
author: robobun
summary: - Since 1.4.0, a byte that is not UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD (`EF BF BD`) in four sinks. `bun run --filter` relays `a\xFFb` as `a\xEF\xBF\xBDb`, and the shell's `which` prints a path that does not exist. - `--outfile=out-\xFF.js --sourcemap=linked` writes `out-\xEF\xBF\xBD.js`. CSS modules in `d-\xFF/` and `d-\xFE/` get one class name. - Cause: `{}` with `bstr::BStr` into a byte buffer (`src/runtime/cli/filter_run.rs:365`). 1.3.14 copied the bytes.

title: Bun.inspect: sort the named properties of an array when `sorted` is set
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.inspect(Object.assign([1], { total: 1, b: 2 }), { sorted: true })` prints `total` before `b`. The option sorts the properties of an object only. - `print_array` always calls the non-indexed property walk (`src/jsc/ConsoleObject.rs:4469`), which has no sorted form.

title: net.BlockList: push new rules onto the end instead of inserting at the front
author: robobun
summary: - The fill of a `net.BlockList` costs the square of the number of rules: 60,000 adds take 1.3 s of JS-thread CPU (Node v26.3.0: 15 ms). - `addAddress`, `addRange` and `addSubnet` each called `Vec::insert(0, rule)` (`src/runtime/node/net/BlockList.rs:152`, `:195`, `:243`), which moves every rule. The front kept the newest rule first.

title: install: do not accept a tarball or git folder as the registry package
author: robobun
summary: Related to #28964 - After a tarball or git dependency moves to the registry at the same version, the hoisted linker keeps the old folder, and `bun install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0: `PackageInstall::verify` compares only name and version. - The same run deletes a dependent's own registry copy, so the dependent loads the old files. `bun update` does this since #38333, the other commands since #44968 (not released).

title: tls: a handshake send that the kernel refuses is a reset, not the owner's FIN
author: robobun
summary: - The kernel refuses the `send()` of a ClientHello, and the owner closes, or writes in `open`, before the next writable event. `Bun.RedisClient` and `Bun.SQL` abort a debug build: `ASSERTION FAILED: !message.isEmpty()` (`Error.cpp(41)`, `JSC::createError`). `Bun.connect` gets `handshake(socket, false, null)`, `WebSocket` an `error` with no code. - Since #44618 `ssl_raw_write` sends a FIN after a refused send. The first check of `ssl_update_handshake` (`packages/bun-usockets/src/crypto/openssl.c:

title: test: clone a key of every WebCrypto key algorithm, and lint the clone table against the algorithm registry
author: robobun
summary: - A WebCrypto algorithm can ship with keys that do not clone, and no test fails. #19674 registered X25519 in Bun 1.2.14. `structuredClone(key)` threw `TypeError: Unable to deserialize data.` until #46021. - The clone codec (`SerializedScriptValue.cpp`) has its own tag for each algorithm. No test compares it with the registry of algorithm names (`CryptoAlgorithmRegistryOpenSSL.cpp:59`). No issue reports the gap.

title: Runtime plugins: positions go through the inline source map of what `onLoad` returned
author: dylan-conway
summary: A runtime plugin that compiles a file (`onLoad` returns new `contents`) moves its lines. Bun reported every position in what the plugin returned, under the name of the file, and a plugin had no way to say where the text came from: an inline source map at the end of `contents` was ignored. `throws.svelte` has 9 lines. `boom()` throws on line 4 and is called on line 6. The plugin returns Svelte's `js.code` followed by `//# sourceMappingURL=` and `js.map.toUrl()`. ``` **A bug, now right** | Case |

title: `bun check`: declare `this[k] = v`, `exports[k] = v` and `f[k] = v` in declaration files as `tsc` does
author: robobun
summary: - `bun check` emits declarations that differ from tsc 7.0.2 for `this[k] = v`, `exports[k] = v` and `f[k] = v`. `this[("a")] = 1` declares nothing: a false `TS2339: Property 'a' does not exist on type 'C'` in a referencing project. - Without parentheses too: `f[E.A] = 1` declares no member. - The transformer names these keys with private copies of typescript-go's functions (`errors_declaration_emit.rs:3332`).

title: css: wrap a one-argument min()/max() sum in calc() and give hypot() one fold for every argument count
author: robobun
summary: Replaces #38654, #38639 and #38501. - `min(1em + 2px)` prints `1em + 2px`, which is not CSS. So do `max()` and a one-argument `hypot()`. `hypot(-3px)` prints `-3px`. - `hypot(.25turn, 135deg, 270deg)` prints `301.906deg`, not `315deg`. - Cause (`Calc::parse_with`, `src/css/values/calc.rs`): these arms return a lone argument as parsed. `parse_hypot` sums squares in a value with a linear unit.

title: test(node:fs): wait for the stat completion before queuing the immediate
author: robobun
summary: - `fs.test.ts` "keeps a non-throwing callback in the same place in the event loop" fails in 25 of 30 runs on a release build. `Expected: "fs-cb:true:true,tick-from-fs-cb,setImmediate"`, `Received: "setImmediate,fs-cb:true:true,tick-from-fs-cb"`. - The child script calls `fs.stat()`, then `setImmediate()` (`test/js/node/fs/fs.test.ts:7226` at `3880151f0a`). The stat runs on the thread pool. The immediate runs first when the completion is not queued at the first immediate phase.

title: install: record the version of tarball and git packages in the lockfile, and audit them
author: robobun
summary: - `bun audit` skips every package from a tarball, git or GitHub: `No vulnerabilities found (checked 0 packages)`, exit 0. - Cause: the lockfile has no version for these rows, so `collect_packages_for_audit` skips them (`src/runtime/cli/audit_command.rs:456` on main).

title: node:net: complete a write that waited for the socket in the async context of the write
author: robobun
summary: - A `socket.write(chunk, cb)` that waits for the socket runs its callback, `'drain'` and `'finish'` with the AsyncLocalStorage store of `connect()` or `listen()`. Node 26.3 uses the write's store. On a keep-alive connection that is another request's. - The write slot in `src/js/node/net.ts` (`kwriteCallback`) kept the bare callback. Socket events complete it, in the context that opened the socket (`src/runtime/socket/Handlers.rs:173`).

title: Remove dead code from JSWebSocket, ArrayBuffer::alloc, and Subprocess
author: robobun
summary: - 29 lines in 5 files have no user. - `getWebSocketConstructor` (`JSWebSocket.cpp`) has no caller. #45223 removed the last one. - No call of `ArrayBuffer::alloc` passes `JSType::Uint8Array`. That arm is the only user of `Bun__allocUint8ArrayForCopy`. The `stdout` and `stderr` entries of the `Subprocess` cached accessor list have no caller.

title: node:http: free the request trailer section when its message is over
author: robobun
summary: - After a chunked request with trailers, an idle `node:http` connection keeps a heap block the size of the trailer section until it closes: 40 KB after a 17 KB section, 18 KB without. - The holder is `nodeHttpRequestTrailers` (`packages/bun-uws/src/HttpResponseData.h:300`). The take move-assigns it into a `thread_local`, and libstdc++ hands the old block back. Where nothing takes it, `clear()` keeps the capacity.

title: Stack traces end under a cycle of awaits: use JSC's guarded await-chain walk and limit it in Error.captureStackTrace (WebKit bump for oven-sh/WebKit#831)
author: robobun
summary: - A stack trace taken under async functions that await each other does not return. `a` awaits `Promise.race([promiseOfB, c()])`, `b` awaits `a`, `c` calls `Error.captureStackTrace({})`: RSS reaches 4 GB, then `panic(main thread): abort() called`. `Error.stackTraceLimit = Infinity` does the same to `new Error()`. A cycle that adds no frame (`Array.fromAsync`) spins at any limit. - Two loops follow the await chain up to the frame limit: JSC's `Interpreter::getAsyncStackTrace`, and a copy in `Async

title: spawn: signal a child that is spawned but not yet watched
author: robobun
summary: - On POSIX, `Bun.spawnSync` can fail to signal a child over `maxBuffer`. `spawn-maxbuf.test.ts` "yes is killed > Bun.spawnSync" fails with `expect(proc.exitCode).toBe(null)`, `Received: 1`, in 16 of 30 runs. A child that stops writing blocks the call. - `Process::kill` (`src/spawn/process.rs:777`) signalled only a watched process. spawnSync reads stdout and stderr and attaches its `AbortSignal` before it watches. A kill requested there returned `Ok(())` with no `kill(2)`.

title: S3: drop every trailing slash of an endpoint
author: robobun
summary: - An S3 endpoint typed with extra trailing slashes, `https://host//` or `https://host/prefix//`, fails every request with `SignatureDoesNotMatch`. - `URL::parse_s3_endpoint` (`src/url/lib.rs:401`) removed one trailing `/`, so `host_with_path` kept a `/` and the signed path became `//bucket/key`. The `S3Client.presign()` URL shows it: `new URL(s3.presign("hello.txt")).pathname` is `//buntest/hello.txt`. - `host_with_path()` returned the bare host for such an endpoint before #39933 (bun 1.4.1), so

title: bun test: a test file that does not resolve fails that file, and the next one runs
author: robobun
summary: - A test file that stops resolving after the scan ends a serial `bun test` run: `error: ModuleNotFound resolving "<path>" (entry point)`, exit code 1, no summary. Later files do not run. - Triggers: with `--watch`, deleting a queued test file (4 of 12 runs). On POSIX, a backslash in a file name. - Cause: the `?` at `src/runtime/cli/test_command.rs:2902`. Each caller of `TestCommand::run` exits on an error.

title: node:util: make aborted() an async function, like Node
author: robobun
summary: Depends on #46120 and #46218, both in this branch. Best after #45575. - `util.aborted()` throws for an invalid argument: `TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The "signal" argument must be of type AbortSignal`. Node rejects the returned promise. - `aborted` is a plain function (`src/js/node/util.ts:649`). Node declares it [`async`](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v26.3.0/lib/internal/abort_controller.js#L607). No user reported it.

title: node:vm: reset the modules that did not link when instantiate() fails
author: robobun
summary: `WEBKIT_VERSION` is the preview build of oven-sh/WebKit#842. Move it to the merged sha before the merge. - A `vm.SourceTextModule` cycle fails to link, the next `link()` gives another module for one specifier, and `evaluate()` crashes: `ASSERTION FAILED: m_moduleEnvironment` at `AbstractModuleRecord.h(278)`, `JSC::AbstractModuleRecord::moduleEnvironment()`. Release: `Segmentation fault at address 0x18`. Node runs it. - JSC keeps the state of a failed `Link()` on the modules that did not link. `l

title: css: read the float channels of an hsl(), hwb() or relative color origin
author: robobun
summary: - A relative color reads the 8-bit bytes of its origin, the color after `from`. `.a{color:hsl(from hsl(30 2% 97%) h 60% 50%)}` prints `#c33`. Chrome 153 computes `#cc8033`. - `parse_color_function` (`src/css/values/color.rs:1143`) rounds `hsl()`, `hwb()` and `rgb()` to `RGBA` at parse. The bytes of this origin, `#f8f7f7`, have the hue 0. - Found by audit for #45362. No user reported it.

title: repl: evaluate a last line that has no newline at the end of piped input
author: robobun
summary: - `bun repl` drops the last line of piped input when it has no newline. `echo -n 'console.log(1)' | bun repl` prints nothing and exits 0. - Cause: at the end of stdin, the key loop in `run_with_vm` (`src/runtime/cli/repl.rs:2346`) leaves. The line in `line_editor.buffer` is lost.

title: worker: give each Worker VM its own transpiler arena and free it with the Worker
author: robobun
summary: Related to #44222 - Each Worker parses the `[define]`, `--define` and `--drop` values again. Nothing frees them when the Worker ends. A 54 KiB string leaves 57 KiB per ended Worker, a short string 64 bytes. - Cause: `init_runtime_state` (`src/runtime/jsc_hooks.rs:359`) gives every VM `Arena::borrowing_default()` as its transpiler arena. 3f1dc29f5e chose that to keep a second heap out of the parser loop.

title: Bun.serve: reset a cut HTTP/1.0 streamed body, and drain a finished response on graceful stop()
author: robobun
summary: - An HTTP/1.0 client reads a streamed `Bun.serve` body until the connection ends. When the server cuts the body, the connection still ends without an error. `curl --http1.0` exits 0 with 12 of 24 bytes. - Four sites close this way: - `HttpContext::onTimeout`: the idle timer, `server.timeout()` - `us_socket_group_close_all_ex`: `server.stop(true)` - `HttpContext::onEnd`: a client half-close - `HttpResponse::closeIfIdle`: a graceful `stop()`, before a finished response drains

title: js_parser: stop the `// @bun` keyword scan at the end of the pragma line
author: robobun
summary: - `Parser::has_bun_pragma` (`src/js_parser/parse/parse_entry.rs:2574`) reads the `// @bun` line for the module loader. It skips the byte after `@bun-cjs`, `@bytecode` or a lone `@`, so it can read past the `\n`. A bare `\r` does not stop it. - `bun build --target=bun --format=cjs` output with `@bytecode` on line 2 makes the loader read `<file>.jsc`. JSC runs that file if it accepts it. - `// @bun @bytecode\nconsole.log("@bun-cjs");` fails with `TypeError: Expected CommonJS module to have a funct

title: node:http2: do not start the readable when END_STREAM comes on a HEADERS frame
author: robobun
summary: - A server `Http2Stream` whose request ends on its HEADERS frame (GET, HEAD) emits `'end'` before anything reads it. A listener added after an `await` of real I/O never gets `'end'`. Node v26.3.0 answers. - Cause: `streamEnd` (`src/js/node/http2.ts:4134`) runs node's full-close `stream.resume()` at the half-close. The client arm (`:5136`) calls `read(0)`.

title: timers/promises: reject an aborted timer on the same tick as Node
author: robobun
summary: - Since Bun 1.4.0, `Promise.race([once(signal, "abort"), setTimeout(ms, v, { signal })])` rejects with `AbortError: The operation was aborted` after an abort. Node and Bun 1.3.14 fulfil. - An aborted `timers/promises` promise rejects 2 ticks after the abort (`src/js/node/timers.promises.ts:84`, `:123`, `:224`). Node takes 6 ticks (4 for `setInterval().next()`). Since #30984, `events.once()` settles on tick 2 or 3 and loses the race.

title: markdown: decide in one place whether a blank line makes a list loose
author: robobun
summary:
- `Bun.markdown.html("- code text ")` gives ` text`: no `

`. The same happens behind HTML of type 6 or 7, and before a marker-only line. CommonMark 5.3 makes these lists loose. - The reverse: `- > - b > - c ` becomes loose, but its `>`-only line is in the quote. - Found by fuzzing, no user report. `- a - [ ] b ` regressed on main with #44805, unreleased.

title: HTMLRewriter: hold a waiting body read in the transform cell instead of a GC root
author: robobun
summary: - `.text()` and the other body readers of an `HTMLRewriter.transform()` output stay a GC root when the input stream never ends. That keeps 6 of 6 disposed `Bun.ModuleGraph`s (`root(ProtectedValues) Promise -> FullPromiseReaction -> Object -storage-> ModuleGraph`) and one realm per file under `bun test --isolate`. - Cause: `PendingValue::set_promise` (`src/runtime/webcore/Body.rs:456`) calls `protect()` until the producer settles the body. Only the collector keeps a `RewriterPipe` alive.

title: Bun.Image: treat an empty Blob or buffer as zero bytes
author: robobun
summary: - `new Bun.Image(await req.bytes()).webp().blob()` on an empty POST rejects `Image: source ArrayBuffer was detached`. `new Blob([]).image()` throws `TypeError: Image() input must be a path string, data: URL, ArrayBuffer, TypedArray or Blob`. - Cause: length stands for kind. `source_from_js` (`src/runtime/image/Image.rs:420`) rejects a Blob with no store. `pin_for_task` (`:739`) reads `len == 0` as detached.

title: install: read a missing lockfile as empty when package.json has nothing to lock
author: robobun
summary: - In a project without dependencies, `bun audit`, `bun outdated` and 14 more print errors like `error: missing lockfile, nothing to audit` and `note: run 'bun install' first`, exit 1. - `bun install` saves no lockfile there (`save_lockfile`, `src/install/PackageManager/PackageManagerDirectories.rs:1299`), so the note cannot be followed. Six load sites read a missing lockfile as "never installed".

title: usockets: do not run a socket's timeout while it waits in the TLS handshake queue
author: robobun
summary: Merge before #45614, #45757 and #45758 (see the notes). - A busy TLS `Bun.serve` resets clients that wait for their handshake. Under `ab -r -n 40000 -c 1000`, Bun 1.4.3 fails 1280 to 1605 requests. Bun 1.4.2 fails 0 to 19. - Since #36403 the timeout sweep fires on sockets parked in the TLS handshake queue (`packages/bun-usockets/src/loop.c:315`). The 10 s request timeout closes a socket whose ClientHello nobody read.

title: Blob: remove the type from the shared byte store
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #35284 - A Blob's `type` also lived on the byte store, so reading one body retyped an unrelated Blob. In the issue's script `original.type` becomes `"application/x-attacker-controlled"`. - That write also frees memory that a Worker reads when it reads `.type` through an object URL (`set_blob_content_type`, `Body.rs:62`). A 4-Worker probe segfaults main in 4 of 4 runs.

title: bake: turn split require off for production builds
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build --app` exits 1 when server code calls `require()` on an ES module: `error: Cannot find module './sf6jz4sb.js' from '/bake:/_bun/qj34pke0.js'`. In `try`/`catch` it exits 0 with the wrong page. bun 1.4.0 builds both (regression from #40519). - Split require prints the call as `import.meta.require("./<chunk>.js")` (`src/bundler/bundle_v2.rs:2264`), which looks for a file. The build keeps server chunks in memory. `Framework::init_transpiler` (`src/runtime/bake/config/transpiler.rs:49`)

title: util.inspect: name a value with a native port of V8's GetConstructorName
author: robobun
summary: - `util.inspect` throws `TypeError: No default value` for `qs.parse("constructor[name][a]=1", { plainObjects: true })`. Nested, it is a `handleMaxCallStackSize assertion failed` error. - Data becomes the type name: `constructor[name]=Admin` prints `[Admin: null prototype]`. A `constructor` getter or Proxy trap runs. - Cause: `internalGetConstructorName` (`src/js/internal/util/inspect.js:2812`) reads `val.constructor?.name`. Node.js asks V8's `GetConstructorName`, which reads own data properties

title: bun:test: wait for a thenable that a withImplementation() callback returns
author: robobun
summary: - `mockFn.withImplementation(impl, callback)` ignores a thenable that `callback` returns. It never calls `then()`, restores the previous implementation at once, and returns `undefined`. A returned supertest request is never sent. Jest 30.5.2 and Vitest 5.0.5 wait. - Cause: `jsMockFunctionWithImplementation` (`src/jsc/bindings/JSMockFunction.cpp:1404`) waits only for a `JSPromise` cell.

title: repl: append each history entry to the history file when it is accepted
author: robobun
summary: - `bun repl` writes `~/.bun_repl_history` only after `.exit`, Ctrl-D or Ctrl-C twice. `process.exit()`, SIGTERM, SIGHUP and SIGKILL lose the session. `docs/runtime/repl.mdx:31` says the history persists. - `History::add` only pushed onto a vector. `History::save` ran after the key loop (`src/runtime/cli/repl.rs:2512`), which these ways out never reach. Bun 1.3.9 kept the history after `process.exit()`.

title: shell: refuse a script whose lexer or sublexer ends inside an open quote
author: robobun
summary: - The Bun shell runs a script that ends inside an open `'` or `"`. `echo "start; touch MARKER; echo done` prints the tail and exits 0. bash and dash refuse it. - `Lexer::lex` reports only an open `$(`, backtick or `(` at the end of input (`src/shell_parser/parse.rs:2919`). It never checks for an open quote.

title: bundler: write a banner's hashbang only as the first line of a chunk
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build --splitting --target=bun --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun' a.js b.js --outdir out` writes a shared chunk that starts with `// @bun`, then `#!/usr/bin/env bun`. `bun out/a.js` fails with `error: Syntax Error` at `out/a-<hash>.js:2:1`. - Only one arm of the chunk header (`src/bundler/linker_context/postProcessJSChunk.rs:401`) takes the hashbang out of the banner. A shared chunk, and an entry point with its own hashbang, write the whole banner after other bytes.

title: node:querystring: parse the default form natively
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45861 - `querystring.parse` of a 3-pair query takes 217 ns in Bun against 151 ns in Node. With `%XX` escapes, 975 against 823 ns. - `src/js/node/querystring.ts` ports Node's per-character loop. On JSC each pair slices a throwaway key, atomizes it, and does a `get` then a `put` in `addKeyVal` (`querystring.ts:339`): 43% of the profile. - The loop predates nodejs/node#66553: a key's escapes mark the value as encoded, so `parse("%C3%A4=caf\u00e9%")` differs from Node.

title: repl: import the JSX runtime for JSX input
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #45915. The source also applies to main (Notes). - JSX in `bun repl` throws `ReferenceError: jsxDEV_7x81h0kn is not defined` under the default (automatic) JSX runtime, at every entry. - `Repl::transform_for_repl` (`src/runtime/cli/repl.rs:2144`) hand-builds its parser options and leaves `features.auto_import_jsx` false. The parser then prints the call without its import (`src/js_parser/parse/parse_entry.rs:2278`).

title: repl: run sloppy sync input as script statements, not inside an arrow function
author: robobun
summary: - In `bun repl`, functions of one input call private copies of each other: after `function rate(){return 3}; function price(n){return n*rate()}` and `function rate(){return 5}`, `price(10)` gives 30 (Node: 50). - A direct eval loses its declarations: after `eval("var q = 1")`, `typeof q` is "undefined". - Cause: each input runs inside `(() => {...})()` (`src/js_parser/repl_transforms.rs:491`), which is its variable scope.

title: http3: tick a connection that another connection's callback acts on, and no connection twice in one pass
author: robobun
summary: - A handler's write to a stream of another HTTP/3 connection waits for that connection's next alarm or packet. curl waits 3991 ms. An idle timeout loses the write. - lsquic skips a tick request while its engine runs a pass: the `ENPUB_PROC` test is engine-wide (`lsquic_engine.c:1719`, `lsquic_stream.c:265`). Handlers run inside that pass (`quic.c:683`). - A packet read while a handler runs the event loop (`Bun.build()`, async plugin) gets the connection ticked twice per pass. Release hangs, debu

title: cli: declare --tls-keylog and --network-family-autoselection-attempt-timeout
author: robobun
summary: - `bun --tls-keylog keys.log app.js` runs `keys.log` as the script: `error: File not found "keys.log"`, or exit 0 when the file is empty. `--network-family-autoselection-attempt-timeout 500` gives `error: Script not found "500"`. - The parser drops an undeclared `--flag` as one token (`src/clap/streaming.rs:208`), so its value is the entry point. node:net reads both flags from `process.execArgv` (`src/js/node/net.ts:252-263`), but no flag table has them. No user reported this.

title: docs: Neon Object Storage in the S3 guide, and an opt-in Neon credentials set in s3.test.ts
author: rishi-raj-jain
summary: Adds [Neon Object Storage](https://neon.com/docs/storage/overview) to the S3-compatible services in `docs/runtime/s3.mdx`, with tests. **Docs** - Adds Neon Object Storage to the list of S3-compatible services. - Adds a "Using Bun's S3Client with Neon Object Storage" section. Each Neon branch has its own endpoint (`https://<branch-id>.storage.<cell>.<region>.aws.neon.tech`). The access key ID and secret come from a Neon credential with the `storage:read` or `storage:write` scope. - Neon takes pat

title: install: write the node-gyp script to the temp directory on an unwritable cache
author: robobun
summary: - `bun install` exits 1 on a warm cache that the user cannot write (read-only mount, another user's cache) when a lifecycle script runs: `error: cannot write files to cache directory "<cache>": EROFS` (or `EACCES`). - The packages are linked by then. The next install prints `no changes`, and the script never runs. - Cause: `ensure_temp_node_gyp_script_run` (`src/install/PackageManager.rs:1401`) writes the `node-gyp` script through `get_temporary_directory`, which exits when no directory renames

title: node:tls: call SNICallback with the connection's TLSSocket as `this` on a listening server
author: robobun
summary: - On a listening `tls.Server` or `http2.createSecureServer()`, Bun runs the `SNICallback` with `this` set to the server. Node v26.3.0 passes the connection's `TLSSocket`. - A callback that uses its socket (`this.destroy()`) throws a `TypeError`: the client gets `ECONNRESET`, the server prints nothing. No affected user is known. - Cause: `ServerHandlers.serverName` (`src/js/node/net.ts:1222`) calls `cb.$call(server, ...)`, and `server` is the `tls.Server`.

title: RegExp: report two pattern-build errors at creation again, fix `v` MayContainStrings (WebKit bump for oven-sh/WebKit#835)
author: robobun

title: repl: keep the line on Down with no newer entry, reset the history cursor at every line start
author: robobun

author: robobun
summary: - In `bun repl`, Ctrl+C in a continuation or `.editor` mode keeps the line being typed. `foo(` Enter, `bar`, Ctrl+C, `2+2` Enter answers `ReferenceError: bar2 is not defined`. - Ctrl+D in `.editor` mode leaves that line at the next prompt. - Cause: `handle_ctrl_c` (`src/runtime/cli/repl.rs:2621`) clears `line_editor` only in its plain-prompt arm. title: Bun.Image: give gray and palette PNG rows of up to 8 bits a row routine
author: robobun

author: robobun

title: Bun.serve: call then() on a returned promise that has its own then()
author: robobun

author: robobun

title: bundler: read the import namespace for a destructured require() of an unwrapped package
author: robobun

title: node:quic: report 'acknowledged' after 'lost' when a late ACK covers the packet

title: Bun.Image: search the palette 4, 8 or 16 entries per step

title: lint: run a built-in plugin natively under any name the config registers it as

author: robobun

title: webcrypto: read only the algorithm name for `exportKey` and `getPublicKey` in `SubtleCrypto.supports`
author: robobun

title: node:http: gate 'drain' on the bytes of the handle, give write callbacks to the stream

title: http3: accept a QPACK field section with no field lines; node:quic sends none for empty hints, or for empty trailers after headers

title: css: read a NaN calculation in a color channel as 0, not `none`
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #45970. - `lab(50% calc(sqrt(-1)) 0)` prints `lab(50% none 0)`. author: robobun

author: robobun
