Its test has three forms: `>-`, `> -` and `> > -`. - The old formula was wrong for more forms that no test has: other containers (`> - -`, `- > -`, `- 1. -`), other spellings of the quote marker (`> -`, `>> -`, ` > -`), and a next line that is a sibling item, a heading or HTML.

title: Run a promise wait as a loop of its own and skip the poll once it settles
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45629, fixes #45020 - Inside `await expect(p).resolves` or `.rejects`, each `setImmediate` hop waits for the poll when any handle is open: 10 hops take 6 to 7 s, under 1 ms with a plain `await`. A wait that is the first await of a file returns about 1 s late. - `EventLoop::wait_for_promise` (`src/jsc/event_loop.rs`) ticks under the caller's frame and inherits `entered_event_loop_count`, so each callback it dispatches is nested and `exit_maybe_drain_microtasks` skips its checkpoint. The ne

title: fix(node:vm): align DONT_CONTEXTIFY script this with globalThis
author: mikamikasuki
summary: Fixes #45102. For a `DONT_CONTEXTIFY` context, `vm.runInContext` evaluated scripts with the realm global as top-level `this`, while the returned context and `globalThis` refer to the special sandbox. This made top-level `this` identity checks fail and broke private-field brand checks on that object. Use the special sandbox as the evaluation `this` value for non-contextified contexts.

title: install: stop when a package.json above cannot say whether the folder is its workspace
author: robobun
summary: - A command typed in a workspace reads each `package.json` above the folder to find the root (`find_workspace_root_above`, `src/install/PackageManager.rs`). Four states of such a file read as "not listed". The folder then ran as its own project, exit 0. - The file is empty next to a lockfile, has an invalid `"workspaces"`, or its listing fails before or at the folder. `bun install` in the root refuses each.

title: fix(worker_threads): preserve WebAssembly Memory64 address type
author: mikamikasuki
summary: Fixes #45739 `SerializedScriptValue` kept the shared WebAssembly memory handle but discarded its address type. Worker deserialization therefore rebuilt Memory64 as i32. Store the address type with each handle and use it when reconstructing the worker's memory.

title: replMode: keep helper imports and lowering temporaries in the wrapper
author: robobun
summary: - replMode hoists every top-level declaration to the global object, also the parser's own (`src/js_parser/repl_transforms.rs:106`). The parser prints the same names for every input. - A decorated class from an earlier input runs the decorators of a later class. With `accessor`, `a.x` throws `TypeError: Cannot read from private field`. - In `bun repl`, a named import overwrites a variable named `import_path`.

title: url: return URL component getters as substrings of the cached href
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45627 - `url.host`, `hostname`, `search` and `pathname` cost 46 to 52 ns per read in Bun, 6 to 8 ns in Node. - Each getter copies the `WTF::URL`, copies the bytes into a new `StringImpl` (`URLDecomposition.cpp`) and wraps that in a new `JSString` (`JSDOMURL.cpp`). `href` is fast because `JSDOMURL::href()` caches its `JSString` in `m_href`.

title: node:http: parse the request trailer section once
author: robobun
summary: - A lenient `node:http` server drops all request trailers when one trailer value holds a control byte. It answers 200, and `req.rawTrailers` is `[]`. Node v26.3.0 delivers them. - It needs `--insecure-http-parser` or `httpValidation`, not `insecureHTTPParser: true`. The review of #45532 found it, no user did. - The trailer section (the fields after the last chunk) is parsed twice. At `'end'`, `Bun__NodeHTTP__parseRequestTrailers` parses it again with `server.insecureHTTPParser === true` (`src/js

title: HTMLRewriter: make an async text handler on a long text node linear
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #43266 (the move to lol-html v3.0.1). Merge that first. - Since 1.4.0 (#36733), an async text handler that suspends on each chunk of a long text node is quadratic: 16 MiB costs 9.0 s of CPU (1.3.13: 0.08 s). - The cause is `raw_input.get(read..).unwrap_or_default().to_vec()` in `TextDecoder::feed_decoder_loop` (`vendor/lolhtml/src/rewritable_units/text_decoder.rs:193`). Every suspension copies the undecoded rest of the text again.

title: css: keep an earlier transform or translate declaration when a target does not support the later one
author: robobun
summary: - With the default targets, `transform: translateY(100vh); transform: translateY(100dvh)` builds to the `100dvh` line alone. A browser without `dvh` has no transform. `translate` has the same defect. - Cause: `TransformHandler::handle_property` (`src/css/properties/transform.rs:954`) replaces the held value with a later typed one and has no target check.

title: usockets: drop the input a read pause left unread when a socket closes behind its FIN
author: robobun
summary: - `node-http.test.ts` "a dispatch that throws while a raw write of the socket is still in its buffer (tcp) > body-to-come" flakes on darwin 26 aarch64: `closed: false` after 10 s. - A read pause leaves the peer's input in the kernel. `close(2)` over it is a reset that drops unsent output: `ECONNRESET` after 2228224 of 8388608 bytes on Linux. macOS 26 can lose the reset (Notes).

title: shell: end a statement at the then/elif/else/fi that follows a compound command
author: robobun
summary: - `if false; then (echo a) else echo b; fi` prints nothing and exits 0 (bash prints `b`). After `fi`, `)` or `]]`, the next `then`, `elif`, `else` or `fi` runs as a command or fails the parse: `Expected "else", "elif", or "fi" but got: Eof`. - Cause: `Parser::parse_stmt` (`src/shell_parser/parse.rs:844`) starts another command there. - No user reported this. A read of the parser found it.

title: docs(bundler): make the cjs sample load in Node.js, document the `.cjs` and `.mjs` output names
author: robobun
summary: - The `format: "cjs"` sample in `docs/bundler/index.mdx` does not load in Node.js in a `bun init` project. It writes `out/index.js`, and `node out/index.js` fails with `ReferenceError: module is not defined in ES module scope`. `bun out/index.js` exits 0. - The paragraph above the sample says the output runs "in both Bun and Node.js". No docs page names a `.cjs` or `.mjs` output. #33706 removed "and outputs `.mjs`" from the `node` target card, which #10607 and #7252 quote.

title: Bun.build: await a pending Promise subclass from plugin setup() through its own then()
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.build()` never returns when a plugin `setup()` returns `Bun.$` or a `Bun.SQL` query. `Bun.serve({ app })` and `[serve.static]` plugins share the code and hang too. - Cause: `runSetupFunction` (`src/js/builtins/BundlerPlugin.ts:401`) chains the private `$then`, which reads the state of the promise. It never calls the `then()` of a subclass, where `Bun.$` starts its work.

title: semver: build ranges through one append cursor and drop the cached tail pointers
author: robobun
summary: - `query::parse` is Undefined Behavior under the aliasing model of the blocking `miri` job. `intersects::tests::is_subset_of` fails there: `Undefined Behavior: reborrow through <tag> at alloc[0x8] is forbidden` at `src/semver/SemverQuery.rs:1027`. No crash is known. - The cause: `Group::or_range` (`SemverQuery.rs:528-536`) and `List::and_range` (`:335-343`) take a `tail` pointer from a `Box`, then move that `Box`. Ranges such as `^16 || ^17 || ^18` reach it in `bun install`.

title: markdown: give a heading that has a link no link to itself
author: robobun
summary:
- With `headings: true`, `Bun.markdown.html()` puts an `` inside an `` when a heading has a link. `## See [the docs](https://example.com/a)` gives `

See the docs

`. - A parser ends the outer link at the inner one: a heading that is one link gets an empty link. - The cause is `leave_block` (`src/md/html_renderer.rs:200`). It wraps the buffered heading in `` and does not read the buffer.

title: markdown: keep letters outside ASCII in heading ids and give each heading its own id
author: robobun
summary: - With `headings`, `Bun.markdown` keeps only ASCII letters and digits in a heading id. `# 日本語` gets `id=""` and `# Über uns` gets `ber-uns`. - Two headings can get one id: `Foo`, `Foo`, `Foo 1` get `foo`, `foo-1`, `foo-1`. - The cause is `generate_slug` (`src/md/helpers.rs:443`). It skips each byte outside ASCII and never records the `foo-1` it gives out.

title: Give the temporary file of a bytecode order file a random name
author: dylan-conway
summary: Processes that record a bytecode order file (`BUN_BYTECODE_ORDER_OUT`) into the same directory at the same time could pick the same temporary name. The second one then fails its exclusive create with `EEXIST` and leaves no order file. `write_replacing` seeded `FileSystem::tmpname` with the pid, so the name was `pid XOR nanoseconds` plus a per-process counter that is always 0 here. Processes started together have pids that differ in a few low bits and reach this line within nanoseconds of each ot

title: Give context identifiers a distinct type and pass the kind of global as an enum
author: robobun
summary: - After 2^31 script execution contexts a new Worker starts as a second main thread: `isMainThread` is true, `parentPort` is null, `terminate()` never settles. `new Bun.ModuleGraph()` gets there in under an hour. - `Zig__GlobalObject__create` (`src/jsc/bindings/ZigGlobalObject.cpp:516`) took the Worker's identifier as an `int32_t`. Negative meant the main thread. `INT32_MAX` meant "draw one", so that Worker got a second identifier and lost its posted tasks.

title: test: fix the EBUSY and connection flakes of bake.test.ts
author: dylan-conway
summary: Fixes the two causes behind the flaky `--watch` tests of `test/cli/bake/bake.test.ts`. In the last 200 builds the file failed 16 times, 14 of them on Windows, with `EBUSY` on `rm`, `ECONNRESET` or `ECONNREFUSED`. **`EBUSY` when the temporary directory is removed.** On Windows `--watch` runs the program in a child of the process the test spawned, in a job that is killed when the parent's handle closes. So the system ends the child after the parent is killed, and `await proc.exited` covers the par

title: fix(bundler): preserve assets after onLoad fallback
author: mikamikasuki
summary: Fixes #45838. When a Bun.build onLoad hook returns undefined for a .node file, the bundler falls back to the file loader without recording the asset metadata expected by the asset path, causing an index-out-of-bounds panic. Record the file-loader asset metadata before scheduling the parse task so fallback processing completes successfully.

title: fix(child_process): emit EPIPE for buffered stdin writes
author: mikamikasuki
summary: Fixes #45882. `child.stdin` wraps a `FileSink`, but small writes can stay buffered. When the child closes stdin, `FileSink.flush()` raises `EPIPE`; the fast path did not flush on each write and could leave the Node `Writable` without its callback error, `error` event, or destroyed state. Flush after each child-stdin write and route synchronous flush failures through `Writable` error handling.

title: macros: add tests for the node_modules guard
author: robobun
summary: - No test contains the message of the macro guard: `For security reasons, macros cannot be run from node_modules.` A change can break the guard (`src/js_parser/visit/visit_expr.rs:714`, `:2323`) and CI stays green. - This PR does not close the hole that it started from: after a hoisted `bun install --backend=symlink`, `bun build` runs a macro that a dependency calls. That fix needs a maintainer decision between two designs.

title: verify-baseline-static: allowlist the UCRT `_powf_special` switch table on Windows x64
author: robobun
summary: - `windows-x64-verify-baseline` fails at one link layout: [build 126987](https://buildkite.com/bun/bun/builds/126987) on main (d7562f260d, #45593) and 18 pull request builds in 5 hours. ``` _powf_special [AVX] (1 insns) 0x014519c364 Vphsubw (AVX) ``` - It is a false positive. `_powf_special` (UCRT) ends with a 9-entry switch table in `.text`, and the scan decodes it as code. At `0x14519c200` the entry `C4 C2 19 05` starts a `VPHSUBW`. #45593 only moved the layout.

title: glob: apply the dot rules to a class that starts with `(` and to `?` before an unclosed `(`
author: robobun
summary: - With `dot: false`, `[(.]a` matches `.a` and `[.(]a` does not. minimatch 3 says no to both. No user reported it. The code is in no release. - The strict loop skips its check for a closed index when the next pattern byte is `(` (`src/glob/matcher.rs:1583`). That is for `*(` and `?(` groups. A class, and a `?` before an unclosed `(`, skip it too. `Program::read` (`:4688`) repeats it.

title: yaml: compare number keys under `<<` by their bits, so NaN is one key
author: robobun
summary: No issue. A fuzz run found this. - `Bun.YAML.parse("a: {.nan: 1, <<: {.nan: 2}}").a` is `{ NaN: 2 }`. For other keys of one YAML type, the key of the mapping wins. - 80,000 `.nan` keys in one merge source (640 KB) take about 5 s. - `yaml_merge_key_expr_eql` (`src/parsers/yaml.rs:1701`) compares number keys with `==`, so NaN never equals NaN.

title: structuredClone: the clone of an error without a position has none
author: dylan-conway
summary: An error that has a `stack` but no `line`, `column` or `sourceURL` gets a clone with `line: 0` and `column: 0`: ```js Error.stackTraceLimit = NaN; const error = new Error("m"); error.stack = "Error: m"; Object.getOwnPropertyNames(error); // ["message", "stack"] Object.getOwnPropertyNames(structuredClone(error)); // ["message", "line", "column", "stack"] ``` Deleting the three properties from an ordinary error gives the same result. ### Cause and fix Both halves are in `src/jsc/bindings/webcore/S

title: test(lint): share runs in js-parsers.test.ts and check how every run ends
author: robobun
summary: - `test/cli/lint/js-parsers.test.ts` takes 68 s to 77 s on debian 13 x64-asan, 1 s to 6 s elsewhere. 56 of its 242 `bun lint` runs start a JavaScript engine, and with LeakSanitizer each ends about 5 s later. - `lint()` normalized every output: 41 s of the runner's thread in a debug build, 29 s for outputs no test reads. - About 100 runs had no exit code checked.

title: node:quic: ignore resetStream() and setBody() on a receive-only stream
author: robobun
summary: - On a unidirectional stream from the peer that is still open, `resetStream()` sends RESET_STREAM and `setBody()` sends STREAM frames. The peer then closes the connection (RFC 9000 section 19.4): `QUIC transport error 5: received RESET_STREAM on send-only stream 3`. - Cause: `QuicStream::reset_stream` and `attach_source` (`src/runtime/node/quic/stream.rs`) act on any stream.

title: fix(websocket): preserve final-frame state during callbacks
author: mikamikasuki
summary: Fixes #45805. When a pending `.rejects` matcher resumes inside a WebSocket message callback, a subsequent valid data frame can be processed before the previous final frame unwinds. Bun incorrectly treated it as a new message inside a fragmented message and closed the connection with code 1002. Track the FIN bit for the current frame separately from the FIN state of the last data frame. This permits reentrant handling after a complete data frame while preserving fragmentation checks across interl

title: fmt: parse integers in a checked u64, continue in u128 only past u64::MAX
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - `parse_with_sign` (`src/bun_core/fmt.rs:899`) is the digit loop behind `parse_int`, `parse_unsigned` and `parse_decimal`. Since the Rust port (#30412) it accumulates in a `u128`. - `parse_int::<i32>("2147483647")` takes 396 x64 instructions. Bun 1.3.14 (Zig) took 278. - No user reported this. Measurements for #45305 found it.

title: node:http: close the connection when a 'connection' or 'secureConnection' listener throws and nothing handles it
author: robobun
summary: - When nothing handles the error of a `'connection'` or `'secureConnection'` listener, Node.js exits at the throw. Since 1.4.0 Bun answers that connection in full and then exits. - The error is only counted (`src/jsc/VirtualMachine.rs:2151`). uWS reads the request before the run ends (`packages/bun-usockets/src/loop.c:579`). - No user reported this. An mTLS check that calls `socket.getPeerCertificate()` throws on Bun (#16834), and the unchecked peer is answered.

title: fix(fetch): clone chunks when cloning request bodies
author: mikamikasuki
summary: `Response.clone()` and `Request.clone()` tee their body streams, but chunks on the two branches currently share mutable `ArrayBuffer` instances. This applies structured cloning to the second tee branch for Fetch body cloning while leaving public `ReadableStream.tee()` behavior unchanged. Fixes #45782.

title: run: read `-s`, `--silent` and `-ws` of a script's `npm run`
author: robobun
summary: - A script `npm run -s build` fails with `error: Invalid Argument '-s'`, also as a `prepare` script in `bun install`. `npm run build --silent` gives `--silent` to the script. - bun rewrites a script's `npm run` to `bun run` (`replace_package_manager_run`, `src/install/lifecycle_script_runner.rs:126`). npm takes `-s` and `--silent` before or after the script's name. `bun run` has only `--silent`, before it.

title: node:wasi: path_open stores the requested rights masked by the maximum of the file type
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #45867 (included here). - `path_open` in `node:wasi` keeps the requested rights for every host file type. A FIFO keeps `FD_SEEK`, so Rust's `read_to_string` on a named pipe returns `Invalid seek (os error 70)`. Node.js v26.3.0 reads it. - `src/js/node/wasi.ts:1443` stores `neededBase` and `neededInheriting`: in uvwasi, the rights that the directory must hold. `stat()` (`:473`) computes the maximum of the file type and drops it.

title: pack: always pack the files that `main` and a string `browser` name
author: robobun
summary: - `bun pm pack` and `bun publish` drop the `main` file when `files` or an ignore rule excludes it. `{"main":"index.js","files":["lib"]}` packs no `index.js` and exits 0. npm packs it. `bun pm diff` reads a folder the same way. - Cause: `published_files` (`src/runtime/cli/pack_command.rs`) forces bins, README and LICENSE. It has no rule for `main`.

title: node:wasi: a hostcall that the rights do not allow returns ENOTCAPABLE
author: robobun
summary: - In `node:wasi`, a hostcall that the rights of the descriptor do not allow returns 63 (EPERM). Node.js v26.3.0 returns 76 (ENOTCAPABLE). wasi-libc maps only 76 to the errno of the call. So `write()` on a descriptor opened `O_RDONLY` sets errno 63. Under Node.js it sets 8 (EBADF). - `CHECK_FD` (`src/js/node/wasi.ts:713`) and `fd_fdstat_set_rights` (`:900`, `:904`) answer `WASI_EPERM`.

title: node:buffer: define Buffer.of as an own static that never reads `this`
author: robobun
summary: - `Buffer` has no own `of`, so `Buffer.of` is the inherited `%TypedArray%.of`, which constructs through `this`. `Promise.resolve(65).then(Buffer.of)` rejects with `TypeError: TypedArray.of requires |this| to be a constructor`. Node gives `<Buffer 41>`. - Cause: `jsBufferConstructorTable` (`src/jsc/bindings/JSBuffer.cpp:3747`) has no `of` row. No user reported it. A comparison with Node found it during #45285.

title: Bun.file().slice(): keep the size unknown for a slice with no end
author: robobun
summary: Related to #1311 - `Bun.file(p).slice(10).size` is 4503599627370485 for a 16-byte file that nothing has stat'd. `text()` still gives the 6 bytes. - `Blob::get_slice` (`src/runtime/webcore/Blob.rs`) takes `self.size` as the default end. For such a file that is `MAX_SIZE` ("not known"), and `get_slice_from` stores `end - start` as a length.

title: Bun.serve WebSocket: fail one connection when memory for an incoming message is refused
author: robobun
summary: - A `Bun.serve` WebSocket server dies with `panic(main thread): Segmentation fault at address 0x0` when the allocator refuses a buffer for an incoming message. Under `prlimit --as=1000MiB`, about 20 peers that each send a 15-byte frame header end it. - `fragmentBuffer` (`WebSocketContext.h:158`) and `dynamicInflationBuffer` (`PerMessageDeflate.h:267`) are peer-sized `std::string`s. On Linux a refused `operator new` returns NULL (`vendor/mimalloc/src/alloc.c:776`), and libstdc++ copies into it. -

title: Bun.cron: wait on a returned thenable or Promise subclass through its own then()
author: robobun
summary: - In-process `Bun.cron()` never calls `then()` on the value its handler returns. A returned `Bun.$` or `Bun.SQL` query never starts, and the job never fires again. A thenable is ignored. - Affected: a non-`async` handler that returns the value itself. No issue reports this. - Cause: `CronJob::on_timer_fire` (`src/runtime/api/cron.rs:1708`) picks the wait with `result.as_any_promise()`, a cell-type test.

title: node:http: stop reading a connection served from JS while the request buffer is full
author: robobun
summary: - On a socket given to `server.emit('connection', socket)`, and for HTTP/1.1 on an `http2` `allowHTTP1` server, an unread request body is buffered in full. A 64 MiB upload holds 67,108,864 bytes (Node: 131,018, PR: 589,824). - Cause: `onHttp1Body` (`src/js/internal/http1_server_fallback.ts:574`) drops the result of `req.push()`.

title: deps: update libarchive to v3.8.10
author: github-actions[bot]
summary: Updates libarchive to version v3.8.10 Compare: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/compare/27cbc7827172698143e440801fc0ba39ccb4f1f5...0c48412be2d94afe1859a807ea7896a18d8900bd Auto-updated by [this workflow](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/actions/workflows/update-libarchive.yml)

title: ci: take the PR file list from git in the pipeline step and stop test shards from asking GitHub
author: robobun
summary: - The pipeline step asks GitHub for a pull request's files. With the quota spent it logs `Error: GitHub API 403 ... API rate limit exceeded` at `getPullRequestFiles` (`scripts/buildkite.ts:450`) and stores no list: 150 of 274 PR builds. - Each of the 160 test shards then asks GitHub (`scripts/runner.node.ts:418`). `getSecret()` leaves `GITHUB_TOKEN` in every test's environment.

title: fs: read offset, length and position as independent slots in write and writeSync
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45607 Supersedes #37647 (same change, rebased onto main after the string re-encoding landed in the same parser). - `fs.writeSync(fd, buf, undefined, undefined, 2)` writes at the current file offset. Node writes at position 2. The same happens for `(0, undefined, 2)`, `(0, null, 2)`, `(undefined, 2, 2)` and for callback `fs.write`. Bun returns `bytesWritten` larger than `length` in some of these shapes. - Cause: the Buffer arm of `args::Write::from_js` (`src/runtime/node/node_fs.rs:3780`)

title: init: do not add @types/bun or typescript that dependencies or optionalDependencies lists
author: robobun
summary: - `bun init` over an existing `package.json` adds `@types/bun` and `typescript` again when `dependencies` or `optionalDependencies` lists them. After `bun add @types/bun@1.1.0`, `bun init -y` adds `devDependencies["@types/bun"] = "latest"`. The nested install prints `warn: Duplicate dependency: "@types/bun" specified in package.json` and replaces 1.1.0 with 1.4.3. - Cause: the three checks in `InitCommand::exec` (`src/runtime/cli/init_command.rs:704-739`) each read one or two groups.

title: css: reset after the number token of a unicode-range
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` breaks a valid `unicode-range` when whitespace follows a range of decimal digits. `unicode-range: U+0131, U+2122` before a line break prints `unicode-range:U131,U2122`, and Chrome 153 reads no range from it. 400 of 24,816 `@font-face` rules from npm font packages hit this (@ibm/plex, lxgw-wenkai-webfont). - The cause is the `Number` arm of `UnicodeRange::parse_tokens` (`src/css/rules/font_face.rs:221`). It keeps the token after the number, so whitespace becomes part of the range te

title: node:test: finish a test after its afterEach and after hooks
author: robobun
summary: - `t.test()` in an `afterEach` or `after` hook does nothing. Node v26.3.0 runs the subtest and counts its failure. - `executeTestNode` (`src/js/node/test.ts`) sets `node.finished = true` before the hooks, so `addTest` drops the call. Node sets it after them. - `before()` in an after hook fails: `Cannot call beforeAll() inside a test.`

title: bundler: redirect a `module.exports = require()` file per import, not per file
author: robobun
summary: - In a bundle, `import lib from "./index.cjs"` reads the wrong object when `index.cjs` is only `module.exports = require("./esm.mjs")`: `app: the default object undefined`. Node prints `app: 1.2.3 function`. - With no default export the build fails: `No matching export in "esm.mjs" for import "default"`. - Cause: the parser returns an empty AST (`src/js_parser/parse/parse_entry.rs`) and every import links to the required file.

title: Bump WebKit: bun build --bytecode builds a function whose jump sizes take 16 passes to settle
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44926 - `bun build --bytecode` aborts on `@google-cloud/tasks` 7.2.1 with `panic(main thread): abort() called`. `--no-optimize-bytecode` avoids it. - The bytecode optimizer re-emits a function until a pass repeats the previous pass's jump offsets, then runs one more pass and asserts that nothing moved. At iteration 16 it also forces every branch wide. When offsets settle at iteration 15, the extra pass is iteration 16, so the forced widening runs in it and the assertion fails.

title: install: bun update --latest leaves a catalog entry that links a workspace package
author: robobun
summary: - After `bun update --latest`, a `catalog:` dependency whose catalog range links a workspace package gets the registry's package. With `"catalog": {"ui": "^0.1.0"}` and `packages/ui@0.1.0`, the entry becomes `^9.9.9`, `apps/web` loads the registry's `ui`, and the registry receives `GET /ui`. - The cause is `steer_used_catalogs_to_latest` (`src/install/PackageManager/PackageJSONEditor.rs:633`). It rewrites each used catalog entry to the tag `latest` before the resolve, and a tag links no workspac

title: css: resolve legacy aliases in the name table and keep them after the property they alias
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` prints a legacy alias before the property it aliases: `a{gap:9px;grid-gap:1px}` becomes `a{grid-gap:1px;gap:9px}`, and 9px applies. Bootstrap 5.0.2 `.form-select` loses `-moz-padding-start` the same way. - `DeclarationBlock::minify` (`src/css/declaration.rs:82`) writes an unknown name such as `grid-gap` at once, while a handler still holds `gap`.

title: bundler: append a CSS module's exports without a lookup per name
author: robobun
summary: - The linker builds the exports object of a `*.module.css` file with `E::Object::put` for each local name (`src/bundler/linker_context/generateCodeForLazyExport.rs:357`). `put` searches all earlier properties (`src/ast/e.rs:1398`): N names cost N(N-1)/2 comparisons. - A generated module of 40,000 names takes 1.92 s of CPU, and 0.08 s as plain CSS. Found by inspection.

title: node:quic: take a destroyed stream's key out of the pending queues
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - #46021 merged the first commit of this PR (a per-session key names a stream in queued events). This PR now holds the rest. - On main, the key of a stream destroyed before lsquic opens it stays in its pending queue until the next grant (`src/runtime/node/quic/session.rs:741`). The queue grows while the peer grants no stream. - main has no test for the second symptom of the merged fix: an HTTP/3 request that got another request's response headers.

title: test: write a chunk that fits the receive window in the peer-reset tests of node-tls-server.test.ts
author: robobun
summary: - `test/js/node/tls/node-tls-server.test.ts`, "reports the reset that arrives while the socket is paused as ECONNRESET, not 'end'" (tls) fails on Linux 6.1: `Expected: 65536`, `Received: 16384`. title: Bound the remote image prefetch of `bun file.md` by a deadline and a byte budget
author: robobun
summary: - On a Kitty terminal, `bun README.md` downloads every `http(s)` image before it prints, with no bound. A dropped connection holds the output for 130 s, a silent host for 360 s. An endless body fills memory. - Cause: `prefetch_remote_images` (`src/runtime/cli/run_command.rs:3455`, main) waits on `done_channel.read_item()` with no timeout, abort or size limit.

author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` fails on `::selection:window-inactive` (`Invalid selector. Invalid pseudo-class after pseudo-element`) and `body:window-inactive` (`Invalid selector. -webkit-scrollbar state found before -webkit-scrollbar pseudo-element`). `a:is(:window-inactive)` builds as `a:is()`. - No Bun user reported this. `@theia/core` 1.76.0 `menus.css:95` and [Tangent `global.css:186`](https://github.com/suchnsuch/Tangent/blob/cb66e82b64d9c92a360ab28071e6d9a1631cec47/apps/tangent-electron/static/global.css

title: css: write the vendor prefixes for user-select, appearance, hyphens and five more properties
author: robobun
summary: **Question for a maintainer:** keep a prefix that the author wrote (this PR, autoprefixer, esbuild), or replace it (lightningcss)? Keeping needs state across the `!important` list. Details in Notes. - `bun build` writes no vendor prefix for `user-select`, `appearance`, `hyphens` and five more properties under its default browsers. The docs say prefixing is on. - The lightningcss `PrefixHandler` was never ported (`src/css/properties/prefix_handler.rs:12`). Port backlog (#14167), no user report.

title: install: save an edited package.json over its own text
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #11536 Two decisions need a maintainer first: decisions 0 and 1 in Notes. - `bun add`, `bun remove`, `bun update` and `bun pm pkg set` delete every comment in package.json, with exit 0 and no message. - Each prints the whole file from its tree with `print_json` (`updatePackageJSONAndInstall.rs:36`). The tree has no comments.

title: css: accept `::marker` directly after `::before` and `::after`
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` refuses CSS that it prints. It lowers `li::before { &::marker {} }` to `li:before::marker`, then fails on it: `error: Invalid selector. Token is not allowed in this state`. `::before::marker` and `::after::marker` fail too. - css-pseudo-4 makes both valid and Chrome 153 keeps them. No user reported this. - The gate in `parse_one_simple_selector` (`src/css/selectors/parser.rs:3275`) refuses every pseudo-element once `AFTER_PSEUDO_ELEMENT` is set. It does not read the name.

title: css: read an @property initial-value on the stylesheet's parser, keep an unmatched value as written
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` fails on valid `@property` rules: `Unexpected token: url(` for `url("data:,")`, `Unexpected token: rgb(` for `rgb(from currentColor r g b)`, `Invalid value` for `syntax: "<string>"` and `"* "`. - A second parser in `PropertyRule::parse` (`src/css/rules/property.rs:117`) had no import records. The typed parsers refuse a value that they do not resolve. - Two build wrong: `1px 2px` for `<length> | <length>+` as `1px`, `light-dark()` as `var()`, which Chrome 153 drops.

title: A WebAssembly.Memory that grows no longer frees bytes that native code has pinned
author: dylan-conway
summary: Native code that reads a buffer while JavaScript can still run pins it. A pin stopped `transfer()` from taking the bytes away, but not a `WebAssembly.Memory` that grows. This segfaults a release build with default options: ```js let memory = new WebAssembly.Memory({ initial: 256, maximum: 1024 }); const view = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).fill(0x61); require("zlib").deflate(view, () => {}); // pins the buffer, reads it on a worker thread memory.grow(1); // detaches the buffer memory = null; Bun

title: `bun check`, `bun lint`: escape control characters of the checked files in `--pretty`, agent and summary output
author: robobun
summary: - `bun check` and `bun lint` print bytes of the checked files raw in `--pretty`, the agent block and the summary. An ESC byte reaches the terminal. A line feed in a module name starts a line, so a file can show a diagnostic that Bun did not report. - Cause: the printers append messages, paths and source lines unencoded (`src/sema/driver/format.rs`, `src/lint/driver/format/excerpt.rs`). #45307 escapes only the excerpt line.

title: process.hrtime: read uv_hrtime(), with no per-process origin
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44869, fixes #44221 - `process.hrtime()` and `process.hrtime.bigint()` count from VM start. Node returns `uv_hrtime()`, with no per-process origin. Bun readings from two processes, Workers or addons do not compare. - Cause: both host functions (`src/jsc/bindings/BunProcess.cpp`) read `Bun__readOriginTimer`, the `performance.now()` clock.

title: node:http2: drop frames on a closed stream, as nghttp2 does
author: robobun
summary: - Since 1.4.0 a `node:http2` client answers each late DATA frame on a reset stream with `RST_STREAM(STREAM_CLOSED)`. A node server ends the session after about 60 such responses. node and Bun 1.3.14 send nothing. - Late HEADERS open a stream that nothing closes. `session.close()` waits until the peer disconnects. - Cause: `handle_headers` and `handle_data` read "no `streams` entry" as a new stream or an error (`src/runtime/api/bun/h2/connection.rs:1040`, `:1637`). No user reported this.

title: sema parser: parse the parts of one text into one file at real offsets
author: robobun
summary: Part of #45163 Behaviour change: none - Native `bun lint` for `.svelte` needs one HIR per component: the `<script>` blocks and every template expression in one `FileBuilder`, at real offsets. `bun_sema_parser` has no such entry point. - `Parts::parse` (`src/sema/parser/summarize.rs`) parses each part twice: in place to find its end, then over the cut text from offset 0. Each part is its own file.

title: Bun.ModuleGraph: keep a graph alive while its Bun.serve() server listens, with or without a handler
author: robobun
summary: @Jarred-Sumner @dylan-conway: `module-graph-gc.test.ts:356` says a listening server keeps its graph. 3 of 9 `Bun.serve` shapes do not, and this PR fixes those. A child, worker, UDP socket or terminal with no callback stops the same way and is left out. Should those be kept? - A `Bun.serve` server with only static routes stops when a collection frees the graph that the host dropped. The port answers ECONNREFUSED, the host exits 0, and `onError` hears nothing. - Only a handler's saved async contex

title: resolver: resolve a tsconfig `paths` target without `./` when no baseUrl is set, as tsc does
author: robobun
summary: **Decision needed:** with no `baseUrl` in the chain, does a `paths` target without `./` resolve as `./` does (this PR, tsc) or stay dropped with a warning (esbuild)? If dropped, only the docs line stays. - The tsconfig in Bun's docs (`"components/*": ["components/*"]`, no `baseUrl`) loses its alias. `TSConfigJSON::parse` (`src/resolver/tsconfig_json.rs:625`) logs `Non-relative path "components/*" is not allowed when "baseUrl" is not set` and drops the target. - With no `node_modules`, auto-insta

title: Bump WebKit (oven-sh/WebKit#825 preview): a fired property replacement watchpoint is a bit, not an allocation per property
author: robobun
summary: Part of #44796 Draft until oven-sh/WebKit#825 merges. `WEBKIT_VERSION` is its preview build, for CI on every platform. The merged commit replaces it before this leaves draft. - On a fresh object with more than 128 properties, the first overwrite of each property costs 150 ns in bun against 11 ns in node. 200 such objects with 800 keys each, overwritten once, grow RSS by 12 MiB. The flru and hashlru npm caches (plain objects as maps) see 6x slower overwrite and `remove` in the report. - The cause

title: js_parser: keep `export default function` a declaration under React Fast Refresh and a lowered top-level `using`
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build --react-fast-refresh` prints `const App = _s(function App() {...}); var App = App;` for `export default function App() { useState() }`. The bundle fails with `error: "App" has already been declared`. Regression from #20812 (1.2.19). - Cause: the function arm of `s_export_default` (`src/js_parser/visit/visit_stmt.rs`) replaced the declaration with a `const` of the same symbol. The linker declares that symbol again. - The dev server throws `Cannot access 'App' before initialization` f

title: bun test: SIGKILL a spawnSync child that is still running 500 ms after the test's timeout
author: robobun
summary: - A test times out inside `Bun.spawnSync`. Bun signals the child once, prints `killed 1 dangling process`, and waits until the child ends. A child that ignores `SIGTERM` holds a 300 ms test for 8004 ms. - The wait loop in `spawn_maybe_sync` (`src/runtime/api/bun/js_bun_spawn_bindings.rs:1895`) has no deadline after that signal.

title: bun test: run the files of each scan in path order and shuffle from that order
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #18987 - `bun test` runs test files in each directory's listing order, which differs per file system and checkout. `--seed=N` shuffles that list, so a seed does not replay elsewhere. The docs promise: "The same seed always produces the same test execution order." - `Scanner::next` (`src/runtime/cli/test/Scanner.rs`) appends files as listed. Only `--shard` and `--parallel` sort.

title: install: link the @types package of a peer into the global store entry
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45563 **Needs a maintainer decision before review**: see Decision. - Under `install.globalStore`, an entry whose peer is typed by a project `@types/*` package stays project-local (the `@types` check in `src/install/isolated_install.rs`), and so does every dependent. The reporter measures 82 MB -> 300 MB and 174 MB -> 616 MB of project-local `node_modules` in React + TypeScript projects. - TypeScript checks a declaration file at its real path and walks up for `@types/*`. From `<cache>/link

title: Bun.serve: apply server.timeout(req, n) to a Bun.file response body
author: robobun
summary: Part of #44732: its file-body fix, which needs no decision. - `server.timeout(req, n)` in a handler is lost when the Response body is a `Bun.file`. The body runs under `idleTimeout` (since 1.3.13, #29202). - `FileResponseStream` called `resp.timeout(idleTimeout)` at start, per chunk and per writable event (`src/runtime/server/FileResponseStream.rs:192`, `:316`, `:393`). That call stores over the handler's value.

title: css: log parser warnings with the Source and a byte position
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #45554 (the first two commits). Merge it first. - `bun build ./a.css` prints `warn: invalid @ rule encountered: '@unknown-rule'` with no `at file:line:column`. In `Bun.build` logs `position.file` and `lineText` are `""`. No user reported this. - `ParserOptions::warn*` (`src/css/css_parser.rs:2924`) logs through `Log::add_warning_fmt_line_col`, which takes a line, a column and no `Source`.

title: bun:sqlite: test and document reuse of a cached statement while an iterate() loop awaits
author: robobun
summary: - No test covers this case: a loop over `db.query(sql).iterate(1)` awaits between two rows, and other code calls `db.query(sql).all(2)` meanwhile. Both get the same cached `Statement`. - Before #45304 the loop then read the rows of parameter 2, with no error. Now it throws `This iterator was invalidated: its statement was run again.` - `docs/runtime/sqlite.mdx` says "It is safe to reuse a cached statement with different parameter values", with no word on such a loop.

title: docs(check): tell task runner users to run one `bun check -b`
author: robobun
summary: Related to #44776 - A task runner (`bun --filter`, Turborepo, Nx) starts one `bun check` process for each package. Each process reads the projects that its package references again. With `-b` it also checks and reports them. The docs do not say this. - On a 67-project test repo, one process for each package executes 506.2 G user instructions. One `bun check -b` at the root executes 34.4 G.

title: shell: keep an interpolated array in the place it is typed in
author: robobun
summary: - An array in a one-word place of a `$` template takes over the next place: ``A=${["a","echo","INJECTED"]} echo tail`` prints `INJECTED echo tail`. - Cause: `handle_template_value` (`src/runtime/shell/shell_body.rs:444`) wrote a space between elements, so the parser saw typed words. Fuzzing found it, not a user.

title: test(harness): close a silent connection after 30 s in the buns that tests spawn
author: robobun
summary: - Tests that install from registry.npmjs.org fail when one connection goes silent. `bun install` prints its banner, then nothing, and the test timeout kills it: `error: Failed to install dependencies: SIGTERM`. - The HTTP client closes a silent connection after 300 s (`src/bun_core/env_var.rs:65-69`). Only then does `bun install` retry. The tests allow 100 to 300 s.

title: test(lint): start the runs of a test together in lint.test.ts, and assert more
author: robobun
summary: - `test/cli/lint/lint.test.ts` takes 172 s to 198 s on debian 13 x64-asan (13 builds of other pull requests). - An ASAN build runs 5 tests of a file at a time (`src/options_types/context.rs:534`). 36 tests start their `bun lint` runs in sequence, and 15 typed-project runs are serial. - `lint()` normalizes every output. On a debug build that takes minutes for one test, and all tests wait.

title: process: emit the two warnings of an unhandled rejection as Node does
author: robobun
summary: - With `--unhandled-rejections=warn` (also `warn-with-error-code`, `strict`), the rejection warning takes `reason.stack` with a plain `putDirect()` (`src/jsc/bindings/BunProcess.cpp:1469`). `Object.keys(warning)` is `["stack"]`. author: robobun
summary: **Blocked on oven-sh/WebKit#836, oven-sh/WebKit#830 and oven-sh/WebKit#837.** Draft until `WEBKIT_VERSION` is a merged commit. - A suspended generator or async function crashes on resume after a debugger or a profiler changes state: `Segmentation fault at address 0x20` in `llint_op_put_to_scope`. title: test(check): speed up the differential tests and compare pass/fail with tsc
author: robobun
summary: - The five `bun check` differential test files take 91 to 289 s per CI release lane (build 126504). They start three processes for each of 2,417 programs. - `inBatches` (`test/cli/check/differential.ts:80`) runs six programs per batch on any core count. A batch waits for its slowest program, and `tsc` waits for both `bun check` runs. - `differential.test.ts` has up to 79 child processes at a time on 4 cores. On a slow machine its tests time out.

title: test(lint): make native-rules.test.ts faster and check how every run ends
author: robobun
summary: - `test/cli/lint/native-rules.test.ts` takes 23 to 27 s on debian 13 x64-asan. Four runs start a JavaScript engine, and LeakSanitizer adds about 5 s to each. One test ran three in sequence. - One test listed the rule pairs once per rule ID (1,021), which blocked the JavaScript thread. - Most runs had only stdout read. A later crash did not fail them.

title: bun build --compile: add --macos-info-plist, written into a reserved __TEXT section
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build --compile` cannot put an `Info.plist` into a macOS executable. - macOS reads a single-file program's `Info.plist` from its `__TEXT,__info_plist` section. `__TEXT` cannot grow after the link.

title: install: entries of one package in bun.lock have to pin one tarball
author: robobun
summary: - bun.lock has one entry for each path of a package. The loader folds them into one package (`append_package_dedupe`, `src/install/lockfile.rs`) and kept the first. The others' tarball URL, git ref and integrity were dropped without a compare. - One added line under an unused key, before a package's own entry, made `bun ci` install that package from another host, exit 0.

title: test(install): speed up npm-arborist.test.ts and tighten its assertions
author: robobun
summary: - `test/cli/install/migration/npm-arborist.test.ts` took 24 s on debian 13 x64-asan (build 126504). Its 57 cases run `bun pm migrate` and `bun install --frozen-lockfile --lockfile-only` one child process at a time: 113 processes. - The snapshot recorded the frozen install as a bare exit code: 1 for 11 fixtures, with no reason. No case read either command's stdout.

title: test: overlap and share the `bun lint` runs of config-files.test.ts
author: robobun
summary: - `test/cli/lint/config-files.test.ts` takes 170 s to 180 s on debian 13 x64-asan (builds 130260, 130261, 130263). - An ASAN build runs 5 tests at a time (`src/options_types/context.rs:527`). About 85 tests start 2 to 9 `bun lint` runs in sequence. - 86 runs host a plugin in JavaScript. Each ends with LeakSanitizer starting `llvm-symbolizer` to match a suppression: 4 s on a debug build.

title: install: fall back to copyfile when linkat fails with EMLINK, ENOTSUP or ENOSYS
author: robobun
summary: - `bun install` exits 1 when `link(2)` is refused with EMLINK, ENOTSUP or ENOSYS: `EMLINK: failed copying files from cache to destination for package p` (hoisted), `EMLINK: Too many links: failed to link package: p@./p.tgz (link)` (isolated). - Cause: `map_linkat_err` (`src/install/PackageInstall.rs`) and `needs_copy` (`src/install/isolated_install/Installer.rs`) copy only on EXDEV, EACCES and EPERM. - Regression since #44968: a hoisted `file:../x` folder on a file system without hard links inst

title: test(fmt): format the Svelte tables in one run per config and compare whole results
author: robobun
summary: - `test/cli/format/svelte/svelte.test.ts` takes 17 s to 23 s on debian 13 x64-asan. It starts 528 `bun fmt` processes for 251 tests. - An ASAN process needs about 0.2 s to start, and ASAN builds run 5 tests at a time (`src/options_types/context.rs:527`). - About 370 come from tables: one process for each table, config and step.

title: css: compute asin, acos, atan, atan2, hypot, cbrt and log in Bun
author: robobun
summary: - One stylesheet builds to different bytes per host: `rotate(atan2(0px, -1px))` is `rotate(180deg)` on Linux and `rotate(3.14159rad)` on macOS. - The CSS parser calls `asinf`, `acosf`, `atanf`, `atan2f`, `hypotf` and `cbrtf` of the C library at 15 places (`src/css/values/calc.rs:749`). Bun 1.3.14 compiled them in. Since 1.4.0, `log(32768, 2)` is below 15.

title: Bun.serve: format the Date header at write time and delete the Date header timer
author: robobun
summary: - The Date header timer wakes an idle process once a second while any socket is connected, client sockets included: 40 `epoll_pwait2` returns per 30 idle seconds. `us_internal_enable_sweep_timer` (`packages/bun-usockets/src/loop.c`) arms it for every linked socket. - The cached Date is stale between timer fires: 3 s old after a handler that blocks for 3 s.

title: usockets: keep the loop turning while TLS handshakes are parked
author: robobun
summary: - On an idle server a TLS handshake can wait seconds to be read. 16 handshakes on connections that the server had parked took up to 3.5 s on main. - `us_internal_handle_low_priority_sockets` (`packages/bun-usockets/src/loop.c`) gives 5 parked sockets back per loop iteration. Then the loop waits for an unrelated timer or event before the next 5.

title: bun test --parallel, repl: act on a signal at once, and survive its repeat
author: robobun
summary: - `bun test --parallel` acts on SIGINT or SIGTERM up to 900 ms late. The REPL ignores it in an `await` with only a timer pending. Both handlers only record the signal, and the poll retries on `EINTR`. - Both make the signal fatal again too early: `abort_all` (`Coordinator.rs`) uninstalled its handler first, the REPL (`repl.rs`) set `SIG_DFL` after each wait. `bun run` delivers one Ctrl-C twice. title: test(lint): make rule-throws.test.ts faster and strengthen its assertions
author: robobun
summary: - `test/cli/lint/rule-throws.test.ts` takes 55 s on debian 13 x64-asan (build #126504), 1.2 s or less elsewhere. - It starts 68 `bun lint` processes, 53 with a JavaScript VM. With leak detection each of those exits about 4 s later, and an ASAN build runs 5 tests at a time. - The format test fails when only one of its runs takes over 1 s: it compares `[s]` with `[ms]`.

title: Remove dead code from bun_http_jsc, the node:http fallback handle, and the c-ares config
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - `src/http_jsc/Cargo.toml` lists `bstr`, and no file in the crate uses it. #45223 removed the last use. - The fallback response handle (`src/js/internal/http1_server_fallback.ts:230`) has a `shouldKeepAlive` member that nothing reads. `ServerResponse` stores its own flag (`src/js/node/_http_server.ts:4045`). - `scripts/build/deps/cares.ts` defines `HAVE_SYS_SOCKIO_H`, `HAVE_WS2IPDEF_H` and `HAVE_IO_H`. title: docs: bun bake
author: alii
summary: This PR adds the docs for `bun bake` (#45682). Merge it when Bake is on in a release build. - `docs/bundler/bake.mdx` (new), in the "Development Server" group: pages in `app/pages/`, `app/server.ts`, the flags, and what `Bun.main`, `import.meta.main` and `process.argv` are under `bun bake`. - `docs/runtime/utils.mdx`: `Bun.main` is an empty string when no file is the entry point, as under `bun bake`.

title: install: key overrides by the name a dependency is declared under
author: robobun
summary: Related to #33192 - `bun install` drops an `overrides` rule for a git, `github:` or tarball dependency. This happens when the fork's `name` differs from the key. It exits 0 and installs the replaced package. On main a rule added to an installed project is dropped too (#44968, unreleased). - Cause: `asked_version` (`src/install/PackageManager/PackageManagerEnqueue.rs:1684`) keyed the lookup by a per-dependency name slot. `name_resolved_row` overwrote it with each fetched package's name.

title: install(hoisted): do not accept a link in the place of a registry package
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #28964 - `bun link --save mylib`, then `bun add mylib`: `node_modules/mylib` stays a link. The hoisted linker accepts a symlink for a registry package if the `package.json` behind it matches. - It also installs nested dependencies and bins through the link. No user reported that. - Cause: `PackageInstall::verify` (`src/install/PackageInstall.rs:1232`) reads through links.

title: bundler: put --banner/--footer in the bytecode ESM module record (flags from a parse, entries from JSC)
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build --compile --bytecode --format=esm --banner 'console.log(import.meta.url);'` builds an executable that dies with `panic(main thread): Segmentation fault at address 0x0`. A banner `await` or `import` fails too, as does `--footer`. - JSC does not parse such a chunk at startup: its module record comes from what the printer printed. The banner and footer are raw text added later (`src/bundler/linker_context/postProcessJSChunk.rs:466`, `:768`).

title: css: dispatch each declaration to the handler that owns its property
author: robobun
summary: - `DeclarationHandler::handle_property` (`src/css/declaration.rs`) offers each declaration to 15 handlers, as lightningcss does. `finalize` calls all 15 for each rule. An unclaimed declaration costs 863 instructions. - Nobody reported slow CSS. Each new handler in the chain (#45814 adds one) costs every declaration a call.

title: install: unlink the bins that a replaced package no longer declares
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #36388 - A replaced package keeps the `bin` names that its new version drops, in `node_modules/.bin` and the global bin dir. The old link dangles or runs a file of the new version. - The old names exist only in the `package.json` that the install replaces. #45307 lists this as still open.

title: glob: scan a group that crosses a path separator with the matcher
author: robobun
summary: Related to #32596 and #24000. Supersedes #32599 and #45087. - `new Bun.Glob("src/{a,b/c}/index.ts").scan()` lists nothing, and `match()` accepts both files. Braces: in 1.4.3 too. - `build_pattern_components` (`src/glob/GlobWalker.rs:2184`) cuts the pattern at each separator, also inside a group. The shell, `workspaces`, `--filter` and `bun lint` use this walker.

author: robobun
summary: - In a `.ts` file, `a ? async(b, ...c) : d` calls `async(b, c)`. title: shell: skip a dead bin link for the script words bun, bunx and node (Windows)
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44761 - On Windows, `bun run <script>` can exit 255 with `error: bin executable does not exist on disk`. - The script starts with `bun`, `bunx` or `node`. A `node_modules\.bin` in `PATH` has a bin link of that name whose target is gone. title: node:quic: give a stream still open at connection close the connection's error
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45500 - A peer closes the connection with an error while a stream is open with no FIN. The pending read ends with `{ done: true }` and `stream.closed` resolves. Node rejects both with the session's error. - lsquic fires each stream's `on_close` while it destroys the connection. The `StreamClosed` arm in `src/runtime/node/quic/session.rs` reported a clean close, so `session.destroy(error)` found no stream left.

title: fs.watch(macOS): report events that FSEvents dropped as ('change', null)
author: robobun
summary: Part of #44780 - On macOS, when FSEvents drops events, each watcher reports `('change', '<name of its own directory>')`. The lost names never arrive. - `events_cb` (`src/runtime/node/fs_events.rs`) ignores the FSEvents stream flags, so a dropped-events event looks like a change of the watched path.

author: robobun

title: Bun.file: do not cache the st_size of a pipe or a socket as the size of the file
author: robobun
summary: - On macOS, a read of piped stdin stops early after `.size`, `exists()` or a `Response` body stats `Bun.stdin`. title: node:test: store a test failure as node's ERR_TEST_FAILURE, with the thrown value as its cause
author: robobun
summary: - `t.error` in a hook and `details.error` of a `run()` `test:fail` event are the raw thrown value. On Node v26.3.0 both are an `ERR_TEST_FAILURE` whose `cause` is that value. - A reporter that reads the cause gets nothing: `@reporters/github` prints `undefined` for 3 of 6 failures (Notes). - `executeTestNode` (`src/js/node/test.ts`) keeps the caught value: `failure = err ?? makeTestFailure("test failed")`. `makeTestFailure` sets no `cause`.

title: node:test: give t.workerId the id of the worker under bun test
author: robobun

Node fails it.

title: http: judge the byte after a gzip member once
author: robobun
summary: - The same `Content-Encoding: gzip` bytes decode differently by read boundary. title: test: refuse an unpublished version number in the test registry with npm's 400
author: robobun

title: markdown: report fenced code to a renderer with its info string, not an offset into the source
author: robobun

author: robobun

title: Bun.build compile: fail the build when the external sourcemap cannot be written
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.build({ compile, sourcemap: "external" })` resolves with `success: true` and empty `logs` when it cannot write the `.map` file. The only trace is `EISDIR: Is a directory: failed to write sourcemap file 'app.map' (open)` on stderr at process exit. - The cause is the `Err` arm of the `.map` write in `do_compilation` (`src/runtime/api/js_bundle_completion_task.rs:559`). It prints, drops the file from the outputs, and keeps `CompileResult::Success`.

title: css: parse ::details-content and ::picker() like ::part()
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build` fails on `::picker(select):popover-open` and `::details-content::before` with `error: Invalid selector. Invalid pseudo-class after pseudo-element`. `::picker(select):is(:popover-open)` builds as `::picker(select):is()`, which matches nothing. 1.4.0 built all three. - #41122 made the names known. `parse_compound_selector` (`src/css/selectors/parser.rs:786`) gives a known pseudo-element the strict state of `::before`.

title: publish: --tolerate-republish exits 0 on the upload's 403 "You cannot publish over the previously published versions"
author: robobun
summary: - `bun publish --tolerate-republish` exits 1 with `403 Forbidden` and ` - You cannot publish over the previously published versions: 1.0.0.`. The docs promise exit 0 "if the package version already exists". - The flag reads only the manifest, before the upload (`src/runtime/cli/publish_command.rs:631`). A stale manifest or a second job lets the upload go out, and `Npm::response_error` exits.

title: bundler: keep a .sqlite import external without the type attribute
author: robobun
summary: - `bun build --target=bun` bundles `import db from "./db.sqlite"` (no `type` attribute) as `import.meta.require("/abs/path/on/build/machine/db.sqlite", { type: "sqlite" }).db`. The bundle opens the build folder's database. - `resolve_import_records` (`src/bundler/bundle_v2.rs`) keeps a sqlite import external only by its attribute, before resolution. A loader from the file name comes later, so `get_ast` (`src/bundler/ParseTask.rs`) prints `source.path.text`.

title: bundler: count a direct eval literal that names __dirname or __filename as a reference
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #13194 - A bundled CommonJS file that reads `__dirname` only through `eval("__dirname")` throws `ReferenceError: __dirname is not defined` (`checkpoint-client` in `@prisma/internals`). - The bundler declares `var __dirname` only for a counted reference (`src/js_parser/parse/parse_entry.rs:1225`). The direct-eval branch (`src/js_parser/visit/visit_expr.rs:1926`) counts only `module` and `exports`.

title: fetch: stop reusing a pooled keep-alive connection before the origin closes it
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45138 - A `POST` through `fetch()` fails with `ECONNRESET` ("The socket connection was closed unexpectedly") when the origin closes idle connections after a few seconds (Turso: 5 s, no `Keep-Alive` header). - The pool (`src/http/HTTPContext.rs`) parks an idle socket for 300 s and hands it out as the origin closes it. Only idempotent methods are retried (#28706).

title: shell: keep the backslash before `#` inside double quotes
author: robobun
summary: - Inside double quotes the Bun shell drops the backslash before `#`. `echo "a\#b"` prints `a#b`. Bash 5.2 and dash print `a\#b`. - The cause is the list of characters that a backslash escapes in double quotes, in `read_char` (`src/shell_parser/parse.rs:3757`). It has the five POSIX characters and also `#`, since the first shell commit (#7748).

title: shell: expand `$?` and `$$`
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #17396 - Bun Shell passes `$?` and `$$` to the command as text, with exit 0. ``await Bun.$`echo $$` `` prints `$$`. - Cause: when `eat_var` (`src/shell_parser/parse.rs`) finds no name after `$`, the lexer keeps the `$` as text.

title: node:wasi: remove path_open's dev/tty and proc/ cases, narrow terminal rights, fix fd_renumber
author: robobun
summary: - `path_open` in `node:wasi` answers two guest paths before it resolves them (`src/js/node/wasi.ts:1368`). `proc/...` returns 8 (EBADF) for a file that exists. `dev/tty` returns descriptor 0, the guest's stdin. - Node.js v26.3.0 opens both as files. Under `bun file.wasm`, a write to `/dev/tty` fails with 63, and `close()` closes the host's stdin.

title: css modules: decide local vs global at parse, fixing :global() exports and `&` inside :global()
author: robobun
summary: Supersedes #38573. - In a CSS module, `.parent { :global(& .x) {} }` prints `.parent_<hash> .parent .x`, which cannot match. - A class or id inside `:global(...)` prints plain, but is exported as `<name>_<hash>`. `styles[n] || n` gives a class no rule has. - Cause: `new_local_identifier` (`src/css/selectors/parser.rs:1191`) makes every class and id a local symbol. The printer's `Global` arm (`src/css/selectors/selector.rs:1111`) prints their original names.

title: fetch, streams: drop one leading UTF-8 BOM in text() and json() of string and stream bodies
author: robobun
summary: - `text()` keeps a leading byte order mark (U+FEFF) for some carriers. `json()` then rejects with `SyntaxError: JSON Parse error: Unrecognized token`. - Carriers: a string, an async iterable, a `node:stream` Readable, a direct `ReadableStream`. A `Uint8Array` or a `Blob` of the same bytes parses. - `Any::to_string` / `Any::to_json` (`Blob.rs`) return a string body with no decode. `finishTextSink` (`JSDirectStreamController.cpp`) keeps the mark since 70e57a7da0 (#7391, 1.0.15).

title: completions: name a command that prints the script when $SHELL is unknown
author: robobun
summary: - `bun completions` with an unknown `$SHELL` (dash, sh, ksh, an empty value) ends with `note: To manually output completions, run 'bun getcompletes'`. - `bun getcompletes` prints names for the completion scripts, not a completion script. - The text is at `src/runtime/cli/install_completions_command.rs:228`.

title: http: stop making two mutable references to the same client or thread state
author: alii
summary: Fixes places in the HTTP client where safe code held two mutable references to the same memory at once, in h2 and h3 request bodies, the HTTP thread's event loop, and proxy writes. Not yet tested locally.

title: node:crypto: pass null as the scrypt callback error on success
author: robobun
summary: - `crypto.scrypt` calls its callback with `(undefined, derivedKey)` when the derivation works. Node passes `null` and documents it: "`err` is an exception object when key derivation fails, otherwise `err` is `null`". - A caller that tests `err === null`, or runs `assert.strictEqual(err, null)`, takes a call that worked for a failure. - The cause is the success argument list in `ScryptJob::then` (`src/runtime/node/node_crypto_binding.rs:1152`). It starts with `JSValue::UNDEFINED`.

title: docs: set NODE_ENV=production in the deployment recipes
author: robobun
summary: - Six Dockerfiles in `docs/`, and the systemd and PM2 guides, start the server with no `NODE_ENV`. `Bun.serve()` then runs in development mode. A handler that throws sends the client the development error page, with the error message, file paths and source lines. - `docs/runtime/http/error-handling.mdx:22` tells the reader to set `NODE_ENV=production` when deploying. The recipes do not. `docker.mdx` sets it in `prerelease` only, and the final stage starts from `base`.

title: node:net: take the last listen() argument as the callback, as node does
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45090 - `net.Server#listen(port, host, undefined, cb)` and `listen(port, undefined, undefined, cb)` start the server and emit `'listening'`, but never call `cb`. `listen(port, undefined, 511, cb)` throws `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`. Metro's `runServer` uses the first form, so `react-native start` never finishes under Bun. - The cause is the positional parser in `Server.prototype.listen` (`src/js/node/net.ts:3916`). It reads `arguments[3]` only when the third

title: node:tls: ask for the server name on the stream TLS engine
author: robobun
summary: - Over a stream that usockets cannot adopt (`emit("connection", duplex)`, TLS in TLS, unflushed writes, `new TLSSocket(stream, { isServer })`), a server-side TLS socket never asks for the server name. `addContext()` and `SNICallback` do not apply (#44618, "Known limits"). - Cause: `SSLWrapper` (`src/uws/lib.rs`), the TLS engine for such a stream, has no step before the certificate is chosen.

title: process: emit 'beforeExit' again only when something holds the event loop
author: robobun
summary: - `'beforeExit'` is emitted twice with nothing scheduled. `bun-server.test.ts` ("unref keeps process alive for ongoing connections") prints `Completed: 10` twice in 7 of 48 debug ASAN runs. - Regression in 1.4.0 (#37075): `is_event_loop_alive()` counts queued tasks, and `on_before_exit` (`src/jsc/VirtualMachine.rs:2204`) emits again after any turn it allows. Another thread queues such a task with no keep-alive: the end of an unread `fetch()` body.

title: FileSystemRouter, bake: do not load TypeScript declaration files as routes
author: robobun
summary: Related to #7210 - `Bun.FileSystemRouter` and the bake pages scan load TypeScript declaration files as routes: `about.d.ts` becomes `/about.d`. - Both loaders compare only the last dot-suffix with the extension list (`src/router/lib.rs:602`, `src/runtime/bake/router/mod.rs:622`), so `.d.ts` passes as `.ts`. - The route name `docs/[...slug].d` is one the parser rejects, so the constructor throws `Catch-all route must be at the end of the path`.

title: css: keep declarations written after a nested rule in place with a nested declarations rule
author: robobun
summary: Part of #45258. Supersedes #38539. Related to #24770. - `bun build` moves a declaration written after a nested rule before it. `a { @media (min-width: 1px) { color: blue } color: green }` (green) builds to `a{color:green}@media (min-width:1px){a{color:blue}}` (blue). - `NestedRuleParser::parse_value` (`src/css/css_parser.rs`) puts every declaration of a body in one list that prints first. - `parse_style_block` wraps declarations of a nested at-rule in `& {}`, which matches no pseudo-element.

title: css: only fold font longhands into `font` when the rule declared a `font`
author: robobun
summary: - A rule can set all seven font longhands: `font-family`, `font-size`, `font-style`, `font-weight`, `font-stretch`, `font-variant-caps`, `line-height`. `bun build` folds them into a `font` the author did not write. - With `font-stretch: 100%` the result is `font:500 100% 14px/21px Arial,sans-serif`. Browsers reject it, so the rule loses its font. A valid made-up `font` resets `font-kerning` and eleven more sub-properties. - Cause: `FontHandler::flush` (`src/css/properties/font.rs:1020`) treats "

title: node:test: check options in node's order and accept a falsy `plan`
author: robobun
summary: - `test("n", { plan: null }, fn)` passes on Node v26.3.0. Bun throws when the file loads: `The "options.plan" property must be of type number. Received null` (`src/js/node/test.ts:2042`). A suite with a `plan` throws too. - Two invalid options give another error than on node. Node checks tags, concurrency, timeout, signal. Bun checks signal first, in three copies. - No user reported this. A comparison with node found it (#45112).

title: deepEquals: compare a same-typed pair once, and pair Set and Map entries as node does
author: robobun
summary: Part of #28760, related to #34830 - Since #34660 (bun 1.4.0 to 1.4.3), `Bun__deepEquals` (`src/jsc/bindings/bindings.cpp`) compares a Set or a Map once per argument order for `assert.deepStrictEqual` and `util.isDeepStrictEqual` (node's entry points). 10 nested Maps read a leaf 2,048 times (node: 2). A Map that holds itself throws `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`. - A scan per entry accepts any deep-equal entry. Node pairs entries one-to-one. Two Sets of 1,000 objects take 51.5 ms

title: Bun.Archive: match files(glob) against the normalized entry name, as extract() does
author: robobun
summary: Related to #44731 - `archive.files(glob)` matches the stored entry name, `archive.extract(dir, { glob })` the normalized one. For a `tar -C dir .` tarball (`./src/a.ts`), `files("src/*")` is empty and `extract` writes the file. - `FilesContext::do_run` passes the stored name to `match_glob_patterns` (`src/runtime/api/Archive.rs:1061`). `extract_to_disk_filtered` normalizes first (`:1358`).

title: dev server: clear the stale bit of a module that is bundled past the end of the stale bit set
author: robobun
summary: Related to #29418 - A page with a stylesheet and over 510 modules reloads in full on the first edit of a self-accepting module: `[Bun] Hot update was not accepted because it or its importers do not call import.meta.hot.accept`. - `receive_chunk` (`src/runtime/bake/dev_server/incremental_graph.rs:596`) clears a file's stale bit only if `stale_files` covers it. A later `insert_empty` or `insert_failure` in that bundle fills those files with `true`.

title: test(harness): remove an inherited BUN_ENV from bunEnv
author: robobun
summary: - With `BUN_ENV=production` exported, `bun bd test test/bundler/bundler_edgecase.test.ts -t NodeEnvDefault` fails 2 of 3 rows. They get `process.env.NODE_ENV` inlined as `"production"` and expect `"development"`. - `bunEnv` (`test/harness.ts`) is the environment of each bun that a test spawns. It copies the shell's environment, without `NODE_ENV` (line 145) but with `BUN_ENV`. - A bun process takes its mode from `BUN_ENV`, then `NODE_ENV` (`Loader::get_node_env()`, `src/dotenv/env_loader.rs:202`

title: node:async_hooks: AsyncLocalStorage.bind() builds its own wrapper and passes the caller's `this` to fn
author: robobun
summary: - `AsyncLocalStorage.bind(fn)` drops the receiver of the call. For `o = { m: AsyncLocalStorage.bind(function () { return this; }) }`, `o.m() === o` is `false`. Node gives `true`. - The cause is `this.snapshot().bind(null, fn, ...args)` (`src/js/node/async_hooks.ts:239`): a native bound function with a `null` receiver.

title: node:http2: take a request out of the client's pending queue when it is destroyed
author: robobun
summary: - A `node:http2` client request that waits for the connect or a stream slot stays in `ClientHttp2Session.#pendingRequests` after `req.destroy()`: 64 of 64 stay alive, 1463 B each. - A closed session counts the dead entry as in flight: `session.close()` waits until the peer closes the socket (nginx: 75 s). - Cause: `Http2Stream._destroy` (`src/js/node/http2.ts`) notifies the session only for a stream with an id.

title: bun test: match -t / --test-name-pattern without regard to case
author: robobun
summary: - `bun test -t 'mixedcase target'` does not run a test named `MixedCase Target`. It prints `error: regex "mixedcase target" matched 0 tests`. Jest runs that test. - The cause is `RegexFlags::None` where the pattern is compiled (`src/runtime/cli/Arguments.rs:1941`). jest-circus 30.5.2 compiles `new RegExp(testNamePattern, 'i')`.

title: dotenv: one process flag makes Bun.build, macros and HTML routes follow --no-env-file
author: robobun
summary: - Under `--no-env-file`, bunfig `env = false` or `--env-file`, a process still reads default `.env` files: in a macro, in `Bun.build()` with `env: "inline"` or a prefix, in an HTML route. The values reach bundles, child processes and Workers. - Cause: these paths run `Transpiler::configure_defines` with default options on the process's env loader (`js_bundle_completion_task.rs:1250`).

title: Make the own properties of native errors configurable
author: robobun
summary: - winston's `format.metadata()` throws `TypeError: Unable to delete property.` on an `fs` error, and `err-code` returns a stand-in object. title: js_printer: print `/* @__PURE__ */` without breaking the code around it
author: robobun

title: css: store a calc() sum as one flat list of terms, and never drop or order a percentage of a length
author: robobun
summary: - A fuzzer found this, not a user. Since 1.4.0 a 6 KB `calc()` sum holds `Bun.color()` for 5.7 s (1.3.11: 2 ms) and `bun pm diff` for 3.2 s. - Older: from 25,796 terms `bun build` dies with SIGSEGV in `Calc<..>::deep_clone` and prints nothing. - Cause: `Calc::Sum` was a binary tree, one `Box` level per term (`src/css/values/calc.rs`). Each pass recursed per term, and both folds cloned it per level.

title: docs: keep the npm or Yarn lockfile in the isolated installs migration guide
author: robobun
summary: - The "From npm/Yarn" recipe in `docs/pm/isolated-installs.mdx` runs `rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json yarn.lock`, then `bun install --linker isolated`. - The `rm` deletes the lockfile that `bun install` migrates to `bun.lock`. author: robobun

Other signed requests reject with `ERR_S3_INVALID_SIGNATURE` from about 3,900. title: event loop: run the immediates left on the macro loop from the regular loop's turn
author: robobun
summary: - `bun main.ts` prints and never exits when a macro returns with a ref'd `setImmediate` pending. `socket.destroy()` in `node:net` queues one (`closeSocketHandle`, `src/js/node/net.ts`). - `setImmediate` queues on the current loop (`enqueue_immediate_task`, `src/jsc/event_loop.rs`), the macro loop while a macro runs. Only a macro's wait ticks it, and the keep-alive holds the loop both share.

author: robobun
summary: - VS Code debug console: `{ let x = 1; x }` fails with `SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier 'x'. Expected a ':' following the property name 'let'.` `return { a: 1 }` prints `1`. - `sanitizeExpression` (`packages/bun-debug-adapter-protocol/src/debugger/adapter.ts:2572`) wraps every input that starts with `{` in parentheses, and strips `return ` after that.

title: node:fs: Windows realpath goes through bun_sys so it works in an AppContainer
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44875 - Inside a Windows AppContainer, `fs.promises.realpath`, `fs.realpath.native` and `fs.realpathSync.native` fail with `EPERM: operation not permitted, realpath 'C:\...'` for every path, including directories the container can read and write. chokidar catches the error, climbs to `dirname()` forever at the drive root, and a sandboxed Bun binary burns one or two cores idle. - The cause: `realpath_inner` (`src/runtime/node/node_fs.rs:7575`) called `uv_fs_realpath`. libuv queries `GetFin

title: pack, publish: exit 1 when a file grows while it is packed
author: robobun
summary: - A file that grows between `fstat` and the reads is packed as its first `st_size` bytes, exit 0. - For an append that is the old file. For a longer rewrite it is a splice of old and new bytes. - #45307 fails a file that shrank. A code review found this half, not a user.

title: Worker: swap process.env for SHARE_ENV only after the worker thread is spawned
author: robobun
summary: Stacks on #44942. - `new Worker()` with `env: SHARE_ENV` replaces `process.env` and `Bun.env` even when it throws `DataCloneError` and starts no thread. Node v26.3.0 keeps `process.env`. Found in review of #44942, not reported. - `ensureSharedEnvStoreForWorker` (`JSEnvironmentVariableMap.cpp:907`) publishes the env store and swaps `process.env`. `JSWorker.cpp:366` calls it before serialization.

title: Handing Bun.stdin.stream() to a child process leaves it readable
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #45068 **The bug.** This throws `TypeError: Invalid state: ReadableStream is locked` (`ERR_INVALID_STATE`) on 1.4.3 and on main. It works on 1.4.2. ```js Bun.spawn(["echo", "child ran"], { stdout: "inherit", stdin: Bun.stdin.stream() }); process.stdin.resume(); ``` A second `Bun.spawn(..., { stdin: Bun.stdin.stream() })` and `for await (const line of console)` fail the same way after the first spawn. **Root cause.** `Bun.stdin.stream()` is one stream, cached on the Blob (`Blob::get_stream_

title: Remove dead code from bun_sema and bun_format: 6 trait impls nothing uses
author: robobun
summary: - 6 hand-written trait impls in `bun_sema` and `bun_format` have no caller and no bound that needs them. - rustc's `dead_code` lint and mordant's `unused_pub` do not check trait impls.

title: worker: fill the error event's filename, lineno and colno
author: robobun
summary: Part of #23473 - In a worker and on the `Worker` object, the `error` event of an uncaught error has `filename ""`, `lineno 0` and `colno 0`. #32342 has the repro. - `WebWorker__dispatchError` (`src/jsc/bindings/webcore/Worker.cpp`) builds both events and set none of the three. `on_unhandled_rejection` (`src/jsc/web_worker.rs`) also dropped the `JSC::Exception`, which holds the throw's stack.

title: fetch test: turn the mid-renegotiation `todo` into a test
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - `fetch.tls.test.ts` keeps "a request that reuses a pooled socket mid-renegotiation gets its answer" as `it.todo`. Its comment says uSockets does not retry the request's write when the renegotiation ends. - #44618 changed that. `bun test --todo` on main reports `this test is marked as todo but passes`. A `todo` does not run in CI, so `fetch` has no test for the retry.

title: glob: look up a folder that the pattern names, do not list its parent
author: robobun
summary: Related to #19631 - `new Bun.Glob("customers/acme/public/*.html").scan({ cwd })` lists `cwd`, `customers` and `customers/acme` to find one name in each. If one has mode 711, it throws `EACCES: permission denied, open 'customers'`. The shell and `bun install` fail too. - A relative pattern starts at `cwd` (`Iterator::init`, `src/glob/GlobWalker.rs`) and matches each literal component against a listing.

title: node:fs: store the Dirent entry type as an own Symbol(type) property
author: robobun
summary: - `assert.deepStrictEqual` passes for a file `fs.Dirent` and a directory `fs.Dirent` of one name. An own-key copy of a `Dirent` answers `false` from `isFile()` and `isDirectory()`. - Cause: `createJSDirentObjectStructure` (`src/jsc/bindings/NodeDirent.cpp:145`) keeps the entry type under a private name. No own key carries it.

author: Jarred-Sumner
