title: Bun.openInEditor: refuse a cmd.exe special character when the editor is a .cmd or .bat file
author: robobun
summary: - On Windows, `Bun.openInEditor` passes the path, line and column to the editor unchecked. For a `.cmd` or `.bat` editor (VS Code's `code.cmd`), cmd.exe reads them as syntax. Build 124163 (tests only): `a&b.js` makes cmd.exe try to run `b.js`. - Since #30412 the argv goes to `sync::spawn` (`src/runtime/cli/open.rs`). 1.3.14 escaped batch arguments (Zig std, by source). No user report.

title: s3: read the bucket of S3File.bucket from the virtual-hosted endpoint host, not the path
author: robobun
summary: - With `virtualHostedStyle: true` and an `endpoint`, `S3File.bucket` returns a key prefix. Endpoint `https://prod-bucket.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`, key `dir/f.txt`: `Bun.inspect(file)` prints `S3Ref ("prod-bucket/dir/f.txt")` and `file.bucket` is `"dir"`. - `get_bucket_name` (`src/runtime/webcore/S3File.rs:623`) never reads `virtual_hosted_style`. #17292 added that mode to `sign_request` and both inspect formatters, not the getter. Found in the code, no user report.

title: node:http2: return {} from session.state without a handle, keep connecting true until the socket is ready
author: robobun
summary: - After `session.destroy()`, `session.state` is `undefined`: `session.state.lastProcStreamID` throws `TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'client.state.lastProcStreamID')`. While a client connects, `state` is populated. Node returns `{}` both times. - Both `state` getters (`src/js/node/http2.ts:4601`, `:5607`) only test the parser. `connecting` reads `socket.connecting`, false through the TLS handshake. `encrypted` is set in the client's constructor, so an early `originSet` read ca

title: undici.request: reject a method that is not a string, not an HTTP token, or CONNECT
author: robobun
summary: - The built-in `undici` accepts a `request()` method that is not a string (`true`) or not a token (`"GET POST"`). It sends `GET`, or `CONNECT` for `"CONNECT"`. - undici rejects each before it connects (`InvalidArgumentError`: `method must be a string`, `invalid request method`, `invalid method`). - Cause: `src/js/thirdparty/undici.js:190` maps a non-string to `null`, and `fetch()` reads `null` as `GET`. No user reported this.

title: logger: search for the end of a line only as far as the excerpt of a diagnostic goes
author: robobun
summary: - For the excerpt of a diagnostic, `scan_line_end` (`src/ast/lib.rs:2542`) searches to the end of the line. An error at the start of a 256 MiB one-line file costs 556 ms. 256 redeclaration errors on one 512 KB line cost 33 s. - Its cursor is 32 bits (`src/bun_core/string/immutable.rs:145`). Above 4 GiB it wraps: a one-line `.jsonc`, `.json5` or `.npmrc` of that size hangs bun. - No user reported it. Code reading found it.

title: json: report the size limit through Source::check_parseable_len, without a position
author: robobun
summary: - A one-line JSON document above 4 GiB hangs bun with no output: `import "./a.jsonc"`, or `bun install` when a registry answers a 4.2 MB gzip manifest that inflates past 4 GiB. - `report_index_error` logs the size error at offset 0 (`src/parsers/json.rs:242`). For a position, the logger searches for the end of line 1 (`scan_line_end`, `src/ast/lib.rs:2530`) with no bound and a 32-bit cursor, which wraps at 4 GiB. Below 4 GiB the error takes 4.7 s (TOML: 1 ms). - No user reported it. Code reading

title: timers: don't promote a `_repeat` timeout that was cleared inside its own callback
author: robobun
summary: - A `setTimeout` with `_repeat` set, cleared inside its first callback, fires again. Node.js fires it once. After a clear by id nothing stops it and the process never exits. - The promotion test in `TimerObjectInternals::fire` (`src/runtime/timer/timer_object_internals.rs:658`) reads only the `_repeat` and `_idleTimeout` slots. `cancel()` records a clear in the `has_cleared_timer` flag, so `convert_to_interval` arms the cleared timer again.

title: node:http2: copy the array values of a raw header list in respond() and request()
author: robobun
summary: - `stream.respond()` and `session.request()` accept a flat `[name, value, ...]` list. `respond([":status", 200, "set-cookie", KEPT, "set-cookie", sid])` pushes `sid` into `KEPT`. - A server with a constant `KEPT` sends each peer the cookies of earlier peers. Affected: 1.4.0 to main, not Node v26.3.0. - Cause: the fold of the list into `sentHeaders` stores the caller's array (`src/js/node/http2.ts:3605`, `:6045`). It pushes a later duplicate of the name into that array, and the list is encoded af

title: js_parser: run an ambiguous file with a label-body or if-body function declaration as CommonJS
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #25737 Stacked on #44741. - The `index.js` of #25737 throws `ReferenceError: bar is not defined`. bun runs the file as a strict ES module, so the function stays block scoped (#44741). Node.js runs it as CommonJS. - Cause: the `ModuleType::Unknown` arm (`src/js_parser/parse/parse_entry.rs:2065`) defaults to ESM. A label-body or `if`-body function declaration was not a CommonJS hint.

title: node-fallbacks: add the dot to a path.format extension and export toNamespacedPath
author: Neekoras
summary: Two divergences between the browser `path` polyfill and Node, found by comparing the two across the module's whole posix surface. **`format` drops the dot before an extension.** Node separates `name` and `ext` with a dot, adding one when `ext` does not start with it: | `pathObject` | Node | polyfill | | --- | --- | --- | | `{ name: "n", ext: "txt" }` | `n.txt` | `ntxt` | | `{ dir: "/a", name: "n", ext: "e" }` | `/a/n.e` | `/a/ne` | | `{ ext: "e" }` | `.e` | `e` | | `{ dir: "/a", name: "", ext: "

title: node:quic: create the endpoint socket without IP_RECVERR and count a refused datagram as sent
author: robobun
summary: - One refused UDP send stalls every session of a `node:quic` endpoint. One forged datagram stalls a `listen()` endpoint for 4 s, a `connect()` to a refused address for 11 s. - On Linux, a dead peer's ICMP error fails sends to live peers. - Cause: the socket has `IP_RECVERR` (`src/runtime/node/quic/endpoint.rs:1376`), and `packets_out` (`:792`) reports each errno except `EMSGSIZE` as `EAGAIN`.

title: Windows: check arguments passed to a .cmd or .bat bin
author: robobun
summary: - On Windows, two launch paths pass an argument to a `.cmd` or `.bat` file without the check `Bun.spawn` makes. cmd.exe reads those arguments again: `%NAME%` becomes the value of an environment variable, and a quote plus `&` starts another command. - The `node_modules\.bin` launcher (`src/install/windows-shim/bun_shim_impl.rs`) appends its argument tail after the `cmd /c "<bin>"` it builds. It runs as `tool.exe` and inside `bun.exe` for `bun run` and `bunx`. - `run_binary_without_bunx_path` (`sr

title: s3, Bun.Archive: use the bytes of an in-memory Blob slice, not its whole store
author: robobun
summary: Found by fuzzing, not by a user. Repro: #43960. - `s3.write(key, blob.slice(0, 11))` stores the whole in-memory Blob: 49 bytes, not 11. A slice of a compiled executable's embedded file does too. - `write_file_with_source_destination` (`src/runtime/webcore/Blob.rs:4567`) takes the PUT body and the resolved count from the source store. - Since 1.4.0 (#31783) a pending Buffer or string write holds its data twice.

title: node:http: copy the array values of a header list in writeHead() and res.headers=
author: robobun
summary: - `res.writeHead(200, ["Set-Cookie", COMMON, "Set-Cookie", sid])` pushes `sid` into `COMMON`. A server with a constant `COMMON` sends each user the cookies of earlier users. The pairs form and `res.headers =` do the same. Affected: 1.4.0 to main, not 1.3.14, not Node v26.3.0. - `_writeHead` folds a header list into the header store with `appendHeader` (`src/js/node/_http_server.ts:2258`, `:2282`). The store keeps an array by reference and `appendHeader` pushes into it (`_http_outgoing.ts:746`).

title: node:stream: wake a pipeline() pump that waits on an idle web stream
author: robobun
summary: - When the client leaves, `pipeline(upstream.body, res, cb)` never calls back while the upstream is idle. An abort hangs the same way, as on Node v26.3.0. - The pump waits in `for await` (`pipeline.ts:113`, `:140` on main). `return()` on that iterator queues behind the pending `next()`.

title: Bun.serve: server.adopt(fd) serves a connection accepted elsewhere
author: oceanwap
summary: Adds `server.adopt(fd)` to the server `Bun.serve()` returns. It takes a TCP connection that some other process accepted (for example a hostname router that read the TLS ClientHello with `MSG_PEEK` and passed the descriptor on with `SCM_RIGHTS`) and serves it exactly as if the server's own listener had accepted it. Why: running several apps on one IP:443 needs something to route by hostname. Today, for `Bun.serve` apps, that router has to stay in the path and copy every byte, because `Bun.serve`

title: AbortSignal: make abort-algorithm identifiers a distinct 64-bit type
author: robobun
summary: - A listener stays registered with `{ signal }`. After 2^32 more `{ signal }` registrations on that signal, `abort()` does not remove it: `RESULT: the first listener SURVIVED abort()`. A pending `pipeTo` is not aborted. - `uint32_t m_algorithmIdentifier` (`src/jsc/bindings/webcore/AbortSignal.h:224`) wraps, and `removeFirstMatching` (`AbortSignal.cpp:319`, `:334`) removes an older live entry. - Found by fuzzing, no user report. Affects v1.3.14 through v1.4.2.

title: `bun check`: refuse paths that have no TypeScript file
author: robobun
summary: - `bun check tsconfig.build.json` prints `No type errors in 0 files` and exits 0. The project has a type error. The docs say that an empty run fails. - The cause is `check_paths` (`src/sema/driver/lib.rs:1550`). It takes any named file as a root of the nearest project. A JSON file is never type checked.

title: `bun check <dir>`: take the files from the projects that list them, not from a glob
author: robobun
summary: - With no root `tsconfig.json`, `bun check .` exits 0 over a type error in a file that a glob cannot find: `.next/types/**/*.ts`, JavaScript behind a `create vite` solution. - `check_paths` (`src/sema/driver/lib.rs`) took candidates from `Project::files_under`, a glob with the config's options and `exclude`, and asked `owner_of` only about those.

title: Bun.serve: leave a Response without a body unused when its request is dropped
author: robobun
summary: - A handler keeps one `Response` without a body, such as `new Response(null, { status: 404 })`, and returns it for every request. After one request that the server does not answer, each later request gets 500 `ERR_BODY_ALREADY_USED`: "Response body already used. A Response body can only be sent once; create a new Response for each request." - A slow handler under the default idle timer is enough to cause it. - `cancel_unread_body` (`src/runtime/server/RequestContext.rs:760`) stores `Body::Value:

title: node:quic: close() waits only for opened streams, and lsquic sends no GOAWAY before HTTP/3 starts
author: robobun
summary: - An HTTP/3 `node:quic` client that calls `session.close()` before its handshake ends, with one stream created, dies: `panic(main thread): Segmentation fault at address 0x8` in `lsquic_frab_list_write`. - `apply_graceful_close` (`session.rs:1917`) calls `lsquic_conn_going_away()`. It writes a GOAWAY through the control stream writer, which a client creates when the handshake ends. - It also counts a pending stream as open, so `close()` can stall 10 s or more.

title: sql: reject non-array values on a nested sql.unsafe() fragment
author: robobun
summary: - A nested `sql.unsafe(text, values)` silently drops `values` that are not an array. SQLite binds NULL for a nested `sql.unsafe("$o", { $o: "bob" })`, also with `strict: true`. Postgres reads the outer `$1` for `${7} and ${sql.unsafe("id = $1", 99)}`. - The nested merge in `normalizeQuery` (`src/js/internal/sql/shared.ts:429`) loops to `sub_values.length`, which an object or number lacks. - Found by a fuzzer, no issue. The `unsafe` JSDoc lists both forms side by side and the types accept them.

title: Dev server: plugin-resolved files, accepts through imports, Windows rename-saves, JSON and CSS modules
author: da-z
summary: Closes #41045 Closes #24067 Closes #18258 Fixes found while serving React apps through a resolver plugin with the dev server on Windows. Each one lost an edit, cost the page its state on an edit, or broke the page. - **A plugin's file path is put in the platform's form.** `onResolve` may answer `C:/app/x.tsx` (a template) or `C:\app\x.tsx` (`Bun.resolveSync`). Everything after keys on those bytes: on Windows the two spellings became two modules, and the watcher, which compares change events agai

title: v8: implement node::Buffer, node::MakeCallback by method name and Value::Int32Value
author: nigrosimone
summary: A nan addon that uses `node::Buffer` can not load in Bun, `dlopen` fails with `undefined symbol: _ZN4node6Buffer6LengthEN2v85LocalINS1_6ObjectEEE`. `libpq` (used by `pg-native`) is one, `canvas` 2.x is another (list in #5835). This adds `node::Buffer` (`HasInstance`, `Data`, `Length`, `Copy`, `New`), the two `node::MakeCallback` overloads that take a method name, and `v8::Value::Int32Value`. title: js_parser: keep a sloppy block-level function as a declaration when no renamer runs
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #23633 Part of #25737 - `{ function z() {} } z()` throws `ReferenceError: z is not defined` in sloppy CommonJS. Node, `utf7` (#13002) and `coffee-script` need it. - `visit_stmts` (`src/js_parser/visit/mod.rs:1580`) rewrites it to `let z = function(){}`. Only a renamer gets the `var` half (`hoist_symbols`, `src/js_parser/p.rs:3705`).

summary: see title Merge after https://github.com/sveltejs/cli/pull/1417

title: Set INIT_CWD to the start directory for scripts and bins that bun spawns
author: robobun
summary: Part of #21088 - `bun run <script>` does not export `INIT_CWD`. npm documents it as the directory `npm run` was called from. - Only `configure_env_for_scripts_run` (`src/install/PackageManager.rs:1086`) writes it, for `bun install` lifecycle scripts.

title: shell: add inheritStdio() to give a command bun's own stdout and stderr
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #37233 Part of #11046 - Under `$`, `isatty()` is false for a command, so programs drop colors and progress bars. - The shell relays and buffers output through pipes (`OutKind::to_subproc_stdio`, `src/runtime/shell/IO.rs:139`). No call gives a command bun's own streams.

title: Bun.serve: end a server.timeout(req, N) override with its response
author: robobun
summary: Found by a fuzz run. Replaces #33611 (stale, unreviewed). - On HTTP/1, `server.timeout(req, N)` stays on the connection after its response. After one `server.timeout(req, 0)` request, Bun never closes that connection. - One per-socket byte held the server's `idleTimeout` and the override (`packages/bun-uws/src/HttpResponse.h:58`). Nothing restored the server's value.

title: Bun.Archive: extract() with a glob rejects at a file or directory that a system call refuses; files(glob) matches normalized names
author: robobun
summary: Related to #43132 **Draft, to be re-cut** (second self-review, Notes). The `files(glob)` half is now #45456. The extract half waits for one answer: with a glob, does a refused mkdir or open reject like `extract(dir)`, or skip? The branch has the first cut. - `archive.extract(dir, { glob })` resolves although entries were not written. `extract_to_disk_filtered` (`src/runtime/api/Archive.rs:1385`, `:1421`, `:1424`) does `continue` after a failed mkdir, open or write. `extract(dir)` rejects. - #453

title: bun-types: declare bytes() on ShellPromise
author: robobun
summary: - ``await $`echo hello`.bytes()`` works at runtime. TypeScript rejects it: `error TS2339: Property 'bytes' does not exist on type 'ShellPromise'`. - #11104 added `bytes()` to `ShellPromise`, `ShellOutput` and `ShellError` in `src/js/builtins/shell.ts`. `packages/bun-types/shell.d.ts` declares it on `ShellOutput` and `ShellError` only.

title: js_parser: parse `export default @dec class` as a class declaration
author: robobun
summary: - `export default @dec class Df {}` leaves `Df` unbound: `ReferenceError: Df is not defined`. With `experimentalDecorators` the decorator never runs. Found by audit. - The `export default` declaration list (`src/js_parser/parse/parse_stmt.rs:1046`) has no `@`, so the class goes to `parse_expr`. That also miscompiles `--minify` bundles and panics `--splitting --minify`: `index out of bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 0`.

title: fetch, Request, server.fetch: stop sending GET for a method outside the method table
author: robobun
summary: Part of #42497 - `fetch()`, `new Request()` and `server.fetch()` silently send `GET` for a method that is not an all-upper or all-lower entry of the method table (`"PatCh"`, `"Put"`, `"BREW"`). - Cause: a table miss becomes `GET` in `fetch_impl` (`fetch.rs:615`), `response::Init::init` (`Response.rs:1303`) and `on_fetch` (`server_body.rs:2303`). The closed `Method` enum cannot hold another token.

title: test: give the 2 GiB printer test its own timeout
author: robobun
summary: - On a slow machine, a release build fails the "printing more than 2 GiB of modules" test of `test/bundler/transpiler/runtime-transpiler.test.ts` with `this test timed out after 5000ms`. - The test (from #42767) requires a 1 MiB module 2,100 times and has no timeout of its own. With a full page cache after a build it needs 5.2 s to 7.6 s

title: Throw a RangeError when the RegExp engine abandons a search
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44697 - Yarr, the RegExp engine, abandons a search after 100,000,000 steps or when its backtracking memory runs out. It reported "no match": `/(?:a|aa)+b|c/.test("a".repeat(35) + "c")` is `false`. - `bun test -t` filtered out a matching test. `Bun.build` skipped a plugin whose filter matches. - `RegExp.lastMatch` after such a search crashed: `Segmentation fault at address 0x4`.

title: dns: read the system resolver config again after a server stops answering
author: robobun
summary: - A resolver whose first query finds no nameserver keeps c-ares's default `127.0.0.1` for ever, so every later `dns.resolve*` fails with `ECONNREFUSED`. Node recovers. Triggers: no free file descriptor, an empty `/etc/resolv.conf`. - `Resolver::get_channel` (`src/runtime/dns_jsc/dns.rs`) creates the channel once and never reads the config again.

title: Bun.password.verify: compare the named algorithm with the hash, throw on a mismatch
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.password.verify(password, hash, algorithm)` and `verifySync` answer `true` for a hash of another argon2 variant than `algorithm`: `verifySync("pw", <$argon2d$ hash>, "argon2id")` is `true`. title: Remove dead code: six trait impls nothing uses
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - Six trait impls in four files have no user. No call reaches them and no bound needs them. - rustc's `dead_code` lint does not report a trait impl, so the workspace's deny lints do not catch them.

title: inspector: --inspect-brk pauses at the start of the entry from JSC, with no injected `debugger;` statement
author: robobun

title: bake: provide every runtime helper from the dev server's bun:wrap module

author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44643, fixes #3440, fixes #12216 - `bunfig.toml` has no `[test]` key for `--isolate` and no key that selects test files by pattern. `isolate = true` and a pattern list in `[test]` are silently ignored (bun 1.4.3). title: Bun.connect: a tls object that sets no option means tls: true
author: robobun

title: node:quic: report a datagram's status under the id kept in its lsquic frame
author: robobun
summary: - Known limitation of #32602: `ondatagramstatus(id, status)` names the wrong id when a datagram is lost ahead of others. title: node:http: deliver every chunk that a corked OutgoingMessage accepts
author: robobun
summary: - `req.cork(); req.write("aaaa"); req.write("bbbbbb"); req.end()` on a chunked `http.request()` sends `4 aaaa | 0 | 6 bbbbbb`. The peer takes 4 of 10 bytes as the body. - `end()` (`src/js/node/_http_outgoing.ts:1086`) sends the last chunk before the chunks buffered under `cork()`. After a spare `uncork()`, `write_()` (`:969`) buffers until `end()`. `uncork()` (`:304`) emits no 'drain', so a corked pipe stops. - Regression from #31587 (bun 1.4.0). Node v21.0.0 to v26.8.2 do the same.

author: robobun
summary: - `i++`, a line break, then `[a, b] = [b, a]` is parsed as `(i++)[a, b] = [b, a];`. `.cjs` files and `bun build` output silently skip the swap. `.mjs` and `.ts` throw `TypeError: Attempted to assign to readonly property.` - `i++[0]` and `i++.y` are accepted. node rejects them. - Cause: `sfx_t_plus_plus` / `sfx_t_minus_minus` (`src/js_parser/parse/parse_suffix.rs:525`) return to the suffix loop, whose member, call and template arms take any left side.

author: dylan-conway

author: robobun
summary: - After one burst, each later request on that `node:http2` session costs more CPU: 14.6 µs before a burst of 5,000, 27.7 µs after. A peer can force it. - A session's three stream tables are `bun_collections::HashMap`. A closed stream leaves a tombstone, so a lookup with no free slot reads the whole table. - Walks read the whole capacity in hash order. On a saturated session, 65 of the first 100 requests get no answer (node 0).

title: Bun.listen / Bun.connect: report a write error when a close loses the queued tail of end(data)
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #41785. - `socket.end(data)` queues what one send does not take. If the connection closes with no read error, nothing reports the loss. TLS on a unix socket: `end()` returned 8388608, the peer got less, `close` got no error. - `NewSocket::on_close` (`src/runtime/socket/socket_body.rs`) reports only a read error or a failed send. A hangup gives the clean code, and TLS hides the errno of a failed send.

title: fetch(s3://): sign with the parsed acl, storageClass and requestPayer
author: robobun
summary: Part of #44289 - `fetch("s3://bucket/key", { method: "PUT", body: "x", s3: { acl, storageClass, requestPayer } })` sends no `x-amz-acl`, `x-amz-storage-class` or `x-amz-request-payer` header. The status is 200. A `ReadableStream` body sends them. GET, HEAD and DELETE drop `requestPayer`. - `fetch_impl` signs with `SignOptions { path, method, ..Default::default() }` (`src/runtime/webcore/fetch.rs:1829`). Only the stream branch reads the parsed options.

title: S3Client.list and new Response(s3File): send requestPayer
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #26778 Part of #44289 (rows 3 and 4) - `S3Client.list()` sends no `x-amz-request-payer` header when the client or the call has `requestPayer: true`. A Requester Pays bucket answers `AccessDenied`. `new Response(s3File)` leaves the parameter out of its presigned `Location`. - Both sites sign with `request_payer: false`: `list_objects` (`src/runtime/webcore/s3/client.rs:265`) and the `Response` constructor (`src/runtime/webcore/Response.rs:1089`).

title: node:http: closeIdleConnections() reads req.complete, and a destroyed request sets it
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44207 Part of #43455 (flow 9) - `server.closeIdleConnections()` in a `'request'` listener, after `res.end()`, closes the connection of that request. Node v26.3.0 keeps it. `closeIfIdle()` (`packages/bun-uws/src/HttpResponse.h:167`) takes an ended response for idle. - A `for await` break or a failed `pipeline()` destroys a request and keeps its connection. `req.complete` then stays `false` after the body arrived. `_destroy` (`src/js/node/_http_incoming.ts:371`) clears `handle.ondata`, whic

title: test(node:http): speed up node-http-upgrade-body.test.ts and make its assertions exact
author: robobun
summary: - `test/js/node/http/node-http-upgrade-body.test.ts` takes 18.97 s on `debian 13 x64-asan` in the parallel batch (build 121810). - It starts one child for each of its 11 rows. An ASAN build runs 5 tests at a time (`src/options_types/context.rs:525`).

title: bun test: compile --test-name-pattern after JSC is initialized
author: robobun
summary: Supersedes #34869 - `bun test -t <pattern>` compiled the pattern while the arguments were parsed, before `TestCommand::exec` initialized JavaScriptCore. No JSC option was set yet, so `Yarr__RegularExpression__init` compiled inside `Options::AllowUnfinalizedAccessScope`, under a `TODO: Remove this` (`src/jsc/bindings/RegularExpression.cpp`). - So no JSC option reached it: `BUN_JSC_dumpCompiledRegExpPatterns=1` did not print it.

title: Test that recursion checks hold with a large environment (needs oven-sh/WebKit#755)
author: robobun
summary: - On Linux, with a stack limit and about 128 KB of arguments and environment, deeply nested input gets `Segmentation fault`: a `[define]` value, `Bun.JSONC.parse`, `new RegExp`. - WTF (`StackBounds.cpp`) measures the main thread's stack bound from below the argument and environment strings, which the kernel counts against `RLIMIT_STACK`. - No user reported it. A review of #41519 found it.

title: spawn: send a sliced Bun.file() at stdin in chunks of its window
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.spawn({ stdin: Bun.file(p).slice(10, 20) })` sends the child the whole file. So do `spawnSync`, `new Response(slice)`, `slice.stream()` and the shell. - `Stdio::extract_blob` (`src/runtime/api/bun/spawn/stdio.rs:565`) turns a file Blob into `Stdio::Path` or `Stdio::Fd`. Neither holds the window.

title: socket: shutdown() sends the FIN after queued bytes; a close frees the queue and keeps bytesWritten
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #44291. - `socket.shutdown()` sends the FIN at once, before bytes that `end(data)` or a node:net write left in the queue. Of 8,388,608 bytes, 2,633,835 arrive, and the peer sees a clean close. `NewSocket::shutdown` (`src/runtime/socket/socket_body.rs`) does not read the queue. - When the peer closes a socket with queued bytes, the queue stays allocated until the GC frees the wrapper: 14,143,312 B for one socket.

title: node-fetch: reject fetch() and body reads with AbortError and FetchError
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44282 - The builtin `node-fetch` module rejects `fetch()` with the native errors: a `DOMException` on abort and a `TypeError` (`ECONNREFUSED: Unable to connect. Is the computer able to access the url?`) on a refused connect. node-fetch 3.3.2 rejects with its own `AbortError` (`type: "aborted"`) and `FetchError` (`type: "system"`, `code`, `errno`, `erroredSysCall`). - `fetch()` in `src/js/thirdparty/node-fetch.ts:195` awaits `Bun.fetch` with no catch. The module exports both classes but ne

title: node:http: create the 'head' Buffer only for a CONNECT or an Upgrade request without a body
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44208 - A `node:http` server copies the bytes behind each request head into a Buffer that JavaScript drops. A 100,000 B POST on loopback copies 100,000 B. 2,000 pipelined GETs copy 54,010,981 B. - `NodeHTTPServer__onRequest` (`src/jsc/bindings/NodeHTTP.cpp:348`) calls `createBuffer` whenever `request->head` is not empty. #25938 added that for CONNECT. No user reported it.

title: Remove dead code from js_printer, bun_io, and UpdateRequest
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - 3 files hold code that has a textual user but cannot run. Example: `print_internal_bun_import` in `src/js_printer/lib.rs` has three `None` arms, and its one caller passes `Some(b"globalThis.Bun")`. - The lints do not report it. rustc's `dead_code` counts a forwarded argument, a flag test and a match arm as a use. `mordant` has no finding for these files.

title: socket: every edit of the pending-write queue goes through one method
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #41785 and #44219. The base branch merges their heads, with no conflict. Behaviour change: none - `NewSocket` edits its queue of unsent bytes at 14 call sites through `buffered_data_for_node_net.with_mut(..)` (`src/runtime/socket/socket_body.rs`). A rule about the queue must be repeated at each site. - Two later changes need one place for such a rule: a FIN that waits for the queue, and an event-loop hold while it has bytes.

title: s3: honor partSize, queueSize, retry, storageClass and acl in writer()
author: robobun
summary: Recommended order: merge #43140 first. - `S3File.writer()` without arguments ignores the `partSize`, `queueSize`, `retry` and `storageClass` of its file or client. `writer({})` uses them. No form of `writer()` sends `x-amz-acl`. - `get_writer` (`src/runtime/webcore/Blob.rs:1643`) passes `Default::default()` and `None` where the store has the values. `writable_stream` (`src/runtime/webcore/s3/client.rs:410`) has no `acl` parameter. - `write(Bun.file(path), { partSize })` has the same defect: it u

title: cli: fix "reponse" typo in publish error message
author: ump45nose
summary: Fixes a user-visible error string in `bun publish`: `missing \`token\` field in reponse json` → `response`. The adjacent generated typings typo (bun-inspector-protocol `index.d.ts`) comes from the protocol definition and was left alone. One-line change; DCO signed off.

title: node:zlib: zstdCompress keeps an explicit pledgedSrcSize and pledges only an exact input size
author: robobun
summary: - `zlib.zstdCompress(input, { pledgedSrcSize: 0 }, cb)` succeeds for a 64-byte input. Node.js fails with `ZSTD_error_srcSize_wrong`. - `createConvenienceMethod` (`src/js/node/zlib.ts:718`) tests `!opts?.pledgedSrcSize`. So a falsy pledge counts as no pledge. - It measures each string as UTF-8, so a latin1 or hex string fails.

title: Delete from HashMap by backward shift, free the entry in console.timeEnd and countReset
author: robobun
summary: - `console.time(label)` + `console.timeEnd(label)` keeps one table slot per distinct label: 35 MB to 450 MB after 10,000,000 labels (node: 144 MB). - `Bun__ConsoleObject__timeEnd` (`src/jsc/ConsoleObject.rs`) keeps the key, because `remove_by_index` (`src/collections/zig_hash_map.rs`) left a tombstone that nothing cleared. After a churn, each lookup of a missing key reads the whole table. - `URL.createObjectURL` + `revokeObjectURL` shows it: 1 us to 27 us a pair.

title: Bun.udpSocket: call the error handler with (socket, error)
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44274 - `Bun.udpSocket` calls the `error` handler with the error only. bun-types declares `error(socket, error)`. - A handler written from the types gets `undefined` as `error`. A read of `error.message` throws `TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'error.message')`, exit code 1. - Cause: the argument list `&[err]` in `UDPSocket::call_error_handler` (`src/runtime/socket/udp_socket.rs:871`), from #7271.

title: One value formatter for console, Bun.inspect, the error printer and bun:test
author: dylan-conway
summary: Bun prints JS values with two formatters. `src/jsc/ConsoleObject.rs` serves `console.*`, `Bun.inspect`, the uncaught-error printer and matcher messages. `src/runtime/test_runner/pretty_format.rs` was forked from it for `bun:test` snapshots and diffs. Both print whatever a program can build, and neither had one place where a value is checked before a printer descends into it: - The stack check, the cycle check and the classifier were per tag and per copy. `Tag::JSX` and `Tag::Proxy` had no guard

title: A Symbol that is a property key of a live object stays alive across GC
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44237 - A Symbol that is reachable only as a property key of a live object is collected. Its WeakMap, WeakSet and FinalizationRegistry entries go, a WeakRef to it clears, and `Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(object)` still returns an equal symbol. The issue's repro loses 115 to 165 of 200 entries; Node loses 0. MikroORM keys a global WeakMap by the symbol from `raw()` and silently drops the WHERE condition after a GC. - JavaScriptCore stores a property key as its `SymbolImpl` (`Structure::m_

title: test/docker: build every service image, never pull one
author: robobun
summary: **Question for a maintainer:** is this rule wanted? Each compose service needs a `build:` section. Notes give the alternative. - A bake of a CI machine image passes when a service image cannot be fetched. `pullImages()` (`test/docker/index.ts:489`) runs `docker compose pull --ignore-pull-failures`, which exits 0 for a refused pull. - Build 120835 baked machine images without the MinIO image. Since #44054 the step fetches only `redis_plain`, which no test starts. No test fails today.

title: node:zlib: reset a zstd stream in place, keep its dictionary and parameters
author: robobun
summary: - `reset()` of a `node:zlib` zstd stream drops its dictionary and parameters. After `createZstdDecompress({ dictionary }).reset()`, a valid frame fails with `ZSTD_error_corruption_detected`. - `Context::reset` (`src/runtime/node/zlib/NativeZstd.rs:461`) called `init()`, which makes a default zstd context. Node did the same until v26.9.0 and keeps the options since v26.10.0 (nodejs/node#65867). No user reported this.

title: test: make the h2 stream-reset flood tests pass on debug builds
author: robobun
summary: - On a debug build, the `stream-reset floods` tests in `test/js/node/http2/h2-conformance.test.ts` fail with `this test timed out after 5000ms` or `timed out waiting for frame`. - 1000 streams take a release build about 30 ms and a debug build 1 to 15 s. The default timeout is 5 s. - The bucket regains 33 tokens per second (`RateLimit::drain`, `src/runtime/api/bun/h2/connection.rs:170`). A flood of 1200 resets that takes more than 6 s never empties it.

title: Bun.Image: resolve the resize target from the JPEG header size and never decode below it
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #44253. Supersedes #44073. - A JPEG and a PNG of the same pixels resize to different sizes: 1179x2556 at width 400 gives 400x865 and 400x867, and 1x100 at width 1 gives 1x13. - `apply_pipeline` resolves the target against the decoded frame (`src/runtime/image/Image.rs:1964`). `run` picks a reduced scale for a JPEG frame before it reads the header (`Image.rs:1650`). - No user reported this. #44073 found it.

title: Bun.Image: split the JPEG decode at the header and read EXIF orientation once
author: robobun
summary: Behaviour change: none - `codec_jpeg::decode` parses the header and picks the IDCT scale in one call. The caller must give the size hint before the header is read, so `PipelineTask::run` guesses it (`src/runtime/image/Image.rs:1647`). - #44254 fixes wrong JPEG resize sizes. It needs the header size before the scale is picked. This PR has no value alone: merge the two together.

title: worker_threads: settle terminate() from the exit handler
author: robobun
summary: - `await worker.terminate()` never continues when code that the Worker's exit handler runs calls it first: a 'message' listener, a stdio 'readable' listener at EOF, or a stdin write callback. - `terminate()` added a native 'close' listener per call (`src/js/node/worker_threads.ts:1074`). The exit handler `#onClose` is the 'close' listener and stored the exit state (`:1209`) after that user code. A listener added during a dispatch does not run.

title: jsc: stop optimized code at its next loop iteration on worker.terminate() and vm timeouts (polling VM traps)
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44216 - A busy `Worker` keeps running JavaScript for 50 to 400 ms after `worker.terminate()`, over a second under load, and a `node:vm` `timeout` overshoots by the same amount. Node stops the worker in under 5 ms. A loop that builds strings (`(big + i).charCodeAt(0)`) keeps running for 100 ms to 1.7 s after `terminate()` on Bun 1.4.3. - The cause is JSC's signal-based VM traps. `VM::notifyNeedTermination()` only sets a bit. A helper thread (`VMTraps::SignalSender`, `VMTraps.cpp:283`) then

title: node:http2: count a refused stream where the session refuses it, not in rstStream
author: robobun
summary: - A `node:http2` server whose handler calls `stream.close(NGHTTP2_REFUSED_STREAM)` sends GOAWAY(ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM) at the 50th refusal. Every other stream on the connection fails with `ERR_HTTP2_SESSION_ERROR`. Bun 1.4.0 to 1.4.2 do this. Bun 1.3.14 and node do not. - The cause is the count in `H2FrameParser::rst_stream` (`src/runtime/api/bun/h2_frame_parser.rs:5052`, from #31584). It counts every REFUSED_STREAM reset that JS submits on a server against `maxSessionRejectedStreams`. `close()` and

title: worker_threads: a worker heap marks on its own thread
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44186 - Eight `worker_threads` workers that allocate in a loop each spend 10 to 36% of their time blocked, against 1 to 3% for one worker alone. - Every JSC heap in the process marks with one helper thread pool. A helper binds to one heap for its whole marking phase, and a collector that has the conn waits for a helper instead of marking (`SlotVisitor::drainInParallelPassively`). With 8 heaps collecting, the pool is taken.

title: Check the result of VM::tryCreate in one helper, Bun::createVM
author: robobun
summary: - `vmForBytecodeCache` (`src/jsc/bindings/ZigSourceProvider.cpp:178`) dereferences the result of `JSC::VM::tryCreate` with no null check. - The two other creation sites check it and panic with `Failed to allocate JavaScriptCore Virtual Machine`. - No report of a null result exists. A forced null ends `bun build --bytecode` with `Segmentation fault at address 0x0`.

title: node:http: half-close from the drain gate when socket.end() waited for buffered bytes
author: robobun
summary: - `res.socket.end()` (`node:http` server) sends no FIN when `res.write()` left bytes buffered and the response never ends: `client: no FIN after 10 s, received 4194472 bytes`. Node sends it. - The native `end()` defers its shutdown while uWS holds bytes (`JSNodeHTTPServerSocket.cpp:348`). The drain gate (`HttpContext.h:980`) shuts down only for an ended response, a peer FIN, or `destroySoon()`.

title: Bun.serve: answer 400 to a request with more than one Host header line
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44232 - `Bun.serve` serves an HTTP/1 request that carries two or more `Host` header field lines. The `fetch` handler runs with `req.url` built from the first line and `req.headers.get("host")` set to the join of all lines (`a.example, b.example`). - RFC 9112 section 3.2 says a server MUST answer 400 to such a request. The parser already answers 400 to a request with no `Host` line (`packages/bun-uws/src/HttpParser.h:1411`), but it never counts the lines.

title: DevServer: dim node_modules frames in error stacks
author: akasakariko
summary: Frames from `node_modules` currently have the same emphasis as application frames. Dim the entire dependency frame in the native error printer and use 50% opacity for dependency frames in the DevServer error overlay. - Match `node_modules` as a directory component, including relative paths, Windows separators, mixed separators, and file URLs. Similar directory names and a file named `node_modules` retain normal styling. - Disable nested name/location colors inside a dimmed terminal frame, and re

title: node:http2: let the server judge content-length on a bodiless request
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44202 - `session.request({ ":method": "DELETE", "content-length": "0" })` fails with `ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_ERROR` (`rstCode` 1, `NGHTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR`). The server never sees the request. Node v26.3.0 answers 200. `GET` and `HEAD` fail the same way. - The cause is a client-side check in `ClientHttp2Session.request` (`src/js/node/http2.ts:6177-6187` and `6212-6222`). It destroys any `GET`, `DELETE` or `HEAD` stream that carries a `content-length` header and ends with its HEADERS frame, befor

title: process: share one hrtime origin across worker threads
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44221 - `process.hrtime()` and `process.hrtime.bigint()` in a `Worker` count from the worker's start. A reading in a worker is as far behind the main thread as the main thread ran before it spawned the worker (about 1000 ms in the issue's repro). Node reads one clock (`uv_hrtime`) on every thread. - The cause: `VirtualMachine::init` (`src/jsc/VirtualMachine.rs:3191`) sets `origin_timer = Instant::now()` for every VM, main and worker. `Bun__readOriginTimer` (`src/jsc/virtual_machine_export

title: ast: keep EString::flatten_rope out of line
author: robobun
summary: - A guard: main is not slower today, no user reported this. #42753 and #38253 add an `ArenaVec<u8>` with `extend_from_slice` to `bun_core`, as the review on #38253 asks. This PR goes first. - With that use, `bun build` pays a call per string: +0.10 % instructions on a 9.1 MB `typescript.js`, +1.98 % on a mime-db import, +28 per line of synthetic JS. - `EString::resolve_rope_if_needed` and `EString::flattened` (`src/ast/e.rs:1899`, `:1908`) inline at every string only while small. In such a build

title: usockets: read a parked socket before acting on its hangup
author: robobun
summary: - On Linux a TLS socket in the handshake queue gets `close` only when its peer's last flight, data and FIN arrive: 22 of 32 sockets in a burst lose 4096 bytes. No user reported it. - The EOF block of `us_internal_dispatch_ready_poll` (`packages/bun-usockets/src/loop.c`) closes a socket that epoll reports as hung up, unread: a TCP socket after `shutdown()`, or a unix socket whose peer closed. #44618 covers the FIN that kqueue reports, not this hangup.

title: bun test: ignore the next original source line in coverage
author: vladislav-miroshnikov
summary: Related to #7662. Support `/* istanbul ignore next */` on its own line as a first next-line coverage directive. It excludes exactly the following original physical source line from line coverage, LCOV and line thresholds; it does not skip blank lines or change function coverage. Capture genuine comments through the parser, carry their line mask through synchronous and async transpilation, and apply it before report aggregation. Template/JSX text and strings do not become directives. With `covera

title: HTTP: cancel unread lazy fetch bodies for HEAD responses
author: vladislav-miroshnikov
summary: Fixes #43970. An untouched fetch Response can still have a pending body producer when a HEAD response discards it, so there is no ReadableStream to cancel and the upstream request stays open. Take and cancel that pending FetchResponseBody producer while preserving the pending-consumer guard and the existing stream cancellation path. This covers the untouched-fetch case explicitly left outside #43973; materialized stream behavior is unchanged.

title: bun:ffi: CString is not a constructor to the engine, `new CString(ptr)` still returns a string
author: robobun
summary: Draft: needs oven-sh/WebKit#739 (pinned as a preview build) and a maintainer decision. Stacked on #44214. - Since 1.4.0, `Array.from.call(CString, [1, 2, 3])` and an array whose `Symbol.species` is bun:ffi `CString` abort the process: `panic(main thread): abort() called`, from `RELEASE_ASSERT(baseValue.isObject())`. 1.3.14 threw a `TypeError` or returned a String object. - `constructFFICString` (`src/jsc/bindings/JSFFICString.cpp`) returns a string primitive by contract (#35246). The engine uses

title: Bun.serve: match routes on the pathname that request.url reports
author: robobun
summary: Fixes #44176 - `Bun.serve` matches `routes` on the raw request-target, while `request.url` comes from the URL parser. `GET /public/..` reaches `/public/:file` with `params.file === ".."` while `request.url` says `/`. `GET /public/../admin` skips the `/admin` route. - `HttpRouter::route()` (`packages/bun-uws/src/HttpRouter.h`) splits `getUrlForRouting()` on `/` only, on HTTP/1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3. `Request::ensure_url` parses the raw target on its own.

title: json: build define values in the arena of their owner and stop sharing one static {}
author: robobun
summary: - Each `new Bun.Transpiler` or `Bun.build` with an object `define` leaks its lists: 126.6 KB for a 4,961-byte value. `DefineData::parse` (`src/bundler/defines.rs:437`) copies the parsed tree into `AstAlloc` lists, which nothing frees. - Every empty JSON source is one shared static `{}` (`src/parsers/json.rs:66`). An empty define and the empty JSON of a macro are one object: `const a = EMPTYX; a.y = 1` reads `a.y` as `undefined`.

title: socket: drain node:net's pending-write queue with a cursor
author: robobun
summary: - A node:net write that one send does not take whole costs CPU by the square of its size. `socket.end(Buffer.alloc(64 << 20))` over a unix socket takes 1,107 ms (Node v26.3.0: 18 ms). No user reported it. - After each partial send, `internal_flush` (`src/runtime/socket/socket_body.rs:3156`) and `write_or_end_buffered` (`:2822`, `:2864`) move all unsent bytes to the front of `buffered_data_for_node_net`.

title: node:os: bench rows and a staged /proc harness for os.cpus()
author: robobun
summary: - Tests cannot give `os.cpus()` a CPU layout that the host does not have. Bun reads `/proc/stat`, `/proc/cpuinfo` and the cpufreq files with raw syscalls, so `LD_PRELOAD` cannot redirect them. - The `node:os` bench has one `cpus()` row. `os.cpus()` is lazy, so that row never measures a read.

title: console, bun:test: print a native function that is not a constructor as a function
author: robobun
summary: - `console.log(Function.prototype)` prints `[Circular]`. `console.log(Proxy.revocable({}, {}).revoke)` prints `{ length: 0, name: "" }`, and a bun:test snapshot prints it as `Function { "length": 0, "name": "" }`. - `Tag::get` gives the Object tag to an InternalFunction that is not a class (`src/jsc/ConsoleObject.rs:2184`, `src/runtime/test_runner/pretty_format.rs:490`). The comment says the rule is for callable namespaces. No function that gets there is a namespace.

title: Make Bun.WebView assignable: drop ReadOnly from its row in the Bun object table
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.WebView = undefined` throws `TypeError: Attempted to assign to readonly property.` in strict mode, and does nothing in sloppy mode. - The only known writer is the Fuzzilli profile (oven-sh/fuzzilli 3c5428b3c7). The line keeps a fuzzed program from starting a browser. It has no effect under the REPRL loop, and it stops a crash file that runs as an ES module. - The cause is `ReadOnly` on the `WebView` row (`src/jsc/bindings/BunObject.cpp:1025`), there since #28185.

title: test(crash_handler): cover the Windows unwind record over the LLInt code
author: robobun
summary: - On Windows, the LLInt and `vmEntry*` code had no unwind record in `.pdata`. A stack walk stopped or derailed at the first interpreter frame. With `BUN_JSC_useJIT=0`, a fault under an interpreted frame exited with `0xC0000005` and no crash report. - oven-sh/WebKit#442 (`b785bfc8`) added the record, and main has it since #35343. No test covers it. Four comments still describe the old state.

title: test(node:http): cover the idle sweep per connection state on the HTTP/1 fallback path
author: robobun
summary: Related to #37717 Behaviour change: none - #43557 and #44032 made the idle sweep of `close()` and `closeIdleConnections()` follow Node.js on the HTTP/1 fallback path. - The tests for that path cover five states: nothing sent, a partial first head, a partial second head, a pending response, and idle. - I found no test on that path for these: - a request body that still arrives after the response ended - a sweep in the tick of `res.end()` - a sweep from the request listener - `closeAllConnections(

title: usockets: bound the accepts of one listener readiness event
author: robobun
summary: - Under connection-per-request load a server that answers inside the accept loop does not leave it. No timer fires and no keep-alive request gets an answer. 4000 connections, 1 ms handler: a 100 ms interval has a gap of 5193 to 5485 ms. - The cause is `do { } while (accept() succeeds)` in `us_internal_dispatch_ready_poll` (`packages/bun-usockets/src/loop.c:522`). An answered client is back in the queue before the next `accept()`.

title: fs: validate POSIX directory records in one parser, report a malformed record as EIO

title: JSON5.stringify: escape unpaired surrogates as \uHHHH
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.JSON5.stringify` writes an unpaired surrogate as is. `Bun.JSON5.parse` reads its input as UTF-8, so the surrogate comes back as U+FFFD: `JSON5.parse(JSON5.stringify("a\uDC00b"))` returns `"a\uFFFDb"`. - The keys `"a\uD800b"` and `"a\uDC00b"` of one object both come back as `"a\uFFFDb"`, so one entry is lost. - The cause is the default arm of `append_quoted_string` (`src/runtime/api/JSON5Object.rs:388`). title: process.nextTick: cheaper check for a Bun.ModuleGraph in the tick loop
author: robobun
summary: Stacked on #43151. - #43151 adds 23 instructions to every `process.nextTick` tick in a program that makes no `Bun.ModuleGraph`. title: Bun.file().slice(): count a negative index back from the file's real end
author: robobun
summary: - `Bun.file(path).slice(-5).text()` returns the first 5 bytes, not the last 5. `slice(0, -1)` keeps the last byte. Reproduced on 1.4.3. - `Blob::get_slice` (`src/runtime/webcore/Blob.rs`) counts a negative index back from `self.size`. Until something stats a `Bun.file()`, that size is `MAX_SIZE`. So `slice(-5)` gets the offset `MAX_SIZE - 5`. The read ignores the failed seek and starts at byte 0.
